880: Umechetza uletatta, da erev zeera. utere arve innun, veal da vegam erev rav ala ittam.

Vechachmeta dilhon, hava saggi. veinnun istakkalu beshate deyoma, veistakkalu bedarga demoshe, vechamu deha bechol sitrin beshesh moshe: beshesh shate kadmain deyoma, deinnun la yachlin leshalletaa behu, (nusach acher begin shit) beshit dargin illain deachdinan beh (nusach acher deachid behu.) uvechol sitrin beshit hava, uveitrin deillen shit, hava zammin laredet min hahar, dichtiv ki voshesh moshe laredet min hahar.

Miyyad vayyikkahel haam al aharon, (dehachi tanenan divhahi shaata denachit moshe vekabbil orayyta bilchodoy kelala dechol yisrael veihu kabbil orayyta bealma. vaafillu mageylet Ester dichtiv 0 vekibbel hayyehudim. vekibbelu hayyehudim mibbae leh. may vekibbel ella da moshe deihu hayyehudim kelala dihudae. vayyakhel haam al ahechan) amay al aharon. begin leitkallela besitra dimina, deha innun semala bau minneh, uvegin deliheve kalil bimina, itkenashu al aharon, vayyomru elav kum ase lanu elohim. (elohim vadday bau setar semala. asher yelchu asher yelech mibbae leh. may asher yelchu. ella elohim shit darga inun 1 kullehu bistar semala deelohim shit inun. dei tema deha sheva inun. hahu elohim ilaa lo al bichlala).

Ta chaze, kol zimna dehava moshe bemitzrayim, shema deelohim la dachir, ella shema daAdonai, veal da kashya leh lefaro begin dela yehe tukepa lehahu sitra achara, vela yittakaf bealma. hasheta bau hahi milla, vehayeynu kum ase lanu elohim. lanu dayyka, deanan tzerichin lehay milla, letakkefa sitra dilan, dehava itdachya ad hasheta.

Asher yelchu lefaninu. may amru. ella hachi amru, chamenan deattun yisrael, kol tuv vechol yekar dealma lechu, vaanan dachyayn levar. dilchu, (Shemot 13:21) vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam. uf hachi elohim asher yelchu lefanenu, kema deazil kamayychu Adonai. deha reshu it lesitra dilan lemehach uf hachi lekamana, i nazmin leh ovada.

Ta chaze, kol anane yekar deazlu bemadbera, la havo chafyayn ella livni yisrael lechodayyhu. vehahu anana dikar, dichtiv vaAdonai holech lifnehem yomam, azla lekamayyhu. veillen erev rav, vechol innun beire anin vetorin, havo azlu levar mimashiryyayta, levatrayyta. veta chaze, kol innun arbein shenin deka azlu yisrael bemadbera, shum lichlucha vetinnufa la hava go anani lego. veal da ane vetore dahavo achle esev levar havo, vechol innun denatre lon.

Amar ribbi elazar, abba, i hachi innun erev rav la havo achle min manna. amar leh vadday hachi hu. ella ma deyahavin lon yisrael, keman deyahiv leavdeh. umimma havo achle. mittamtzit, ma deishtear mibbatar rechaya, pesolet. ukera achriz veamar, (Shemot 16:35) uvene yisrael achlu et hamman arbaim shana. bene yisrael, vela achara. vayyiru veni yisrael vayyomru man hu, vela shear erev rav, ani vetore, dahavo benayyhu.

Ad hasheta, havo itkafyayn innun erev rav vehasheta kamu uvau ovada, leattakfa lesitra achara. amru, o nehe kullana amma chada, veneheve bichlala immechon, o yehe lan man deyyehach kamana, kema deyyehach elahachon kamechon. amar aharon, chas veshalom deillen yishtattefun beamma kaddisha, lemehve kolla kelala chada, vela yitarvun amma kaddisha beamma da, kelala chada, ella tav ihu leafresha lon miggo amma kaddisha, ad deyete moshe.

Veaharon letav itkevavn, ella saggiin havo miyisrael deishtattafu bahadayyhu belibba. uvegin kach, kad ata moshe, itzterich levarra ulelabbena leamma kaddisha mehahu chova, veashke lon shakyu, ad deitberiru
881: Kullehu vela ishtear behu pesolet kelal.

Amar lon aharon, (Shemot 32:2) paraku nizme hazzahav, vechi la hava lon dahava achara. ella amar aharon, beod deit lon ketata bivnayyhu uvenashayyhu, yitakkevun, uven kach yete moshe. ta chaze, tanenan kashim gerim leyisrael kessappachat bivsar hachay, kol shekken illen, dela havo gerim kedka yeot. innun ma avdu. vayyitparaku kol haam et nizme hazzahav asher beaznehem. kama alfe verivvavn havo minnizmehon tamman.

Ma ketiv, vayyikkach miyyadam vayyatzar oto bacheret vegomer. aharon la istammar, meinnun teren chakkimin, dahavo bereshehon dehahu erev rav. chad minnayyhu hava kameh, veachara hava avid becharshoy. kevan detarvavyyhu ityayatu kachada, natlu hahi dahava, (chad) teren shelishe bida dechad, ushelish bida deachara. begin dehachi itzterich behahu zina decharsha.

Bacha rabbi shimon, amar i chasida kaddisha, aharon meshicha deelaha rabba, bachasidutach naflu kama meamma kaddisha. veant la havet yada leistammera. mahu avadu. kad matu shit shaattin, veyoma hava bematkela, natlu hahu dahava defariku meudenehon. may tama. begin deman deitzterich lemebad charsha, la bae lemechas enoy al mamona. veinnun amri, shaata kayyayma lan, i anan la meakkevin. lav shaata lemechas al dahava, miyyad vayyitparaku kol haam. may vayyitparaku. kema deat amer (Melachim 1 19:11) mefarek harim umeshabber selaim, dechabbilu vetavru udenayyhu. bacha kemillekaddemin veamar i amma kaddisha i amma kaddisha, dekudesha berich hu.

Patach rabbi shimon bevichya, veamar, (Shemot 21:6) vehiggisho adonav el haelohim vegomer. ha ukemuha chavrayyay, ozen deshama besinay, (Vayikra 25) ki li vene yisrael avadim vegomer. veihu parik ol malchut shamayim mealeh, vezavin garmeh leacher, tiratza. veillen chayyayvayya reshiin, guverin bishin, betiuveta dilhon lemehadar lesarchanayyhu, la bau minneshehon uvenehon ella chavilu urechayyhu (sefer acher udenayyhu) veitperaku meol shemaya defakid lehu moshe, vetavru udenayyhu, delet lon chulaka bishma kaddisha, veamma kaddisha.

Ma avadu. peligu tarvavyyhu hahu dahava, chad natil teren shelishin, vechad shelish. kamu lokovel shimsha, beshit shatin. avadu charshayyhu, uvaltu belatehon becharsha defuma. kevan demata sheruta dishva, arimu tarvavyyhu yedayyhu al yedoy deaharon. (umenalan dameydea detarvayhu yad mikkol chad natal velo yattir) dichtiv vayyikkach miyyadam, tarvavyyhu havo, vela yattir. kevan deihu kabbil miyyadam (sefer acher tere velo yedehem), kalla nafik veamar, (Mishlei 11:21) yad leyad lo yinnake ra, dichtiv ki vera hu. ayyte ra lealma.

Raza demilla. innun reshaim chayyayvin charshin benoy devilam chayyayva, beni benoy delavan reshia, chamu dechos shel beracha bimin ihu, umin yemina ittakaf tadir. (sefer acher yattir) amru, i yehe bistar da, hahu resha dimina, ha tukepa dilan kedka yeot.

Kevan demata sheva shatin deyoma, yahavu leh leaharon miyyad. i ihu hava amar lon shavu leh beara bekadmita, vaana etol, la havo yachlin becharshayyhu kelum, ella miyyadam natal. ukera mitraam veamar, vayyikkach miyyadam, chamu ma avad aharon gevar nevia gevar chakkim, la yada leistammera, deillu natil meara, kol charshin dealma la havo yachlin leatzlecha. aval bema atzlachu beovada da, begin devayyikach miyyadam vela meara.

(Shemot 32:4) vayyatzar oto bacheret, lav kema dechashvin bene nasha, deavad tziyyurin bimchuga, o bemilla achara. ella ata kera leochacha milla, deaharon la yada leistammera. ilu kad natal miyyedehon, hava shadde leara, veaf al gav deyittol leh levatar, la hava
882: Atzlach ovada bisha da. aval becholla siyyua bisha hava, denakit dahava, utemareh meena, bish batar bish, may vayyatzar oto bacheret. deshavve kol dahava bechisa chada, veistemar meena. keden salik kolla leovada.

Besifra dechanoch ashkachna, dehava amar hachi, bera yechidaa yityyeylid lehahu risha chivvavra, vechad yiyitun mibbisra dachamare, yatin leh, behahu deayil (nusach acher denatil) margelan bezagin dedahava, bela data dileh, udeyyukena yetzuyayr betziyyura bacheret. may bacheret. becheret enosh. da kolmusa deenosh chayyayva, deate livne nasha.

Vadday da berira demilla, deenosh kad ate alma, bekolmusa hava rashim reshimin, dechol diukenin ufulchanin nochrain behahu kolmusa, (sefer acher rashim reshimin) veal da ketiv bacheret, hahu deishtemoda lemebad hachi. veda hu beriru demilla.

Vecholla hava, devadday bechisa arme dahava, vechasse leh meena, kema deamru innun charshin, vehachi itzterich bezine decharashin illen. veda hu ovada decharshin illen, milla deitzterich beitgalleya, leitgallaa levatar, itzterich temiru vechisuya bekadmita, deyitkase meena, uvatar yippok umana leumanuteh. umilla deitzterich bechissuya levatar, itzterich beitgalleya bekadmita.

Hasheta banay rechimay, rechimin denafshay, ma abid, vadday itzterichna legallaa, atzitu veatmiru millin. bistar kedushsha hahu, elohim dikshot, melech al alma, bitlat (milin) almin (illen) ittakkaf. (Bereshit 177 amud bet, Rosh Chodesh amud alef) bibberia. biytzira. baasiyya. veha ittemar, raza dechol chada vachada hacha. lokovel beria, vayyikkach miyyadam, mila dela hava beh ad kean kelum. lokovel yetzira, vayyatzar oto bacheret. lokovel asiyya, vayyaasehu egel massecha. man chama charshin bechol alma keillen.

Hasheta it lememar, vechi la ketiv vaashlichehu baesh, vela yattir, ucheden vayyetze haeggel hazze. vehashsheta at amart vayyaasehu egel massecha ella chas veshalom deaharon avad, ukera ochach dichtiv vayyikkach et haeggel asher asu. aval mimma dichtiv vayyikkach miyyadam, uchetiv vayyatzar oto. mechela ditren illen, itavid kolla. kivyachol hu avid leh, dei teren illen la havo, la itavid vela nafak leumanuta. aval man garam deitavid. innun teren. (kivyachol vayyaasehu ihu vadday osehu) beod deihu lakach miyyadam, inhu avde charshayyhu, umelachashe befumayyhu, umeshache rucha letatta, min sitra achara.

Umeshachu teren ruchin kachada, chad min dechar, vechad min nukeba. dechar itlavash bediyyukena deshor. nukeba bediyyukena dechamor, tarvavyyhu havo kelilan kachada. amay teren illen. ella shor ha ittemar. chamor amay. begin decharshin illen demitzrae, ketiv behu, (Yechezkel 23:20) asher besar chamorim besaram.

Veal da, kol innun deyisrael demitu, itchabbaru bahadayyhu belibbehon. uvegin dahavo teren diukenin, ketiv elle elohecha yisrael, vela ketiv ze, ella elle, teren havo kachada, asher heelucha meeretz mitzrayim. heelucha vela heelcha ketiv.
(Shemot 32:4) vayyaasehu egel massecha vayyomru. vayyomer la ketiv, ella vayyomru, deaharon la amar midi. tanenan, (Vayikra 79 amud alef) mea veesrim vechamesh kanterin havo beh.
Hech ketiv vayyikkach miyyadam, vechi beyadam havo kol illen kanterin. ella mikkelala deinnun kanterin natlu male yedayyhu. vehahu zeer, istallak al kolla, keillu hava kolla bidayyhu.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv vayyar aharon vayyiven mizbeach lefanav. i chasida kaddisha, kama reutach hava letav, vela yadat leistammera. kevan dearme leh benura, ittakkaf chela desitra achara tamman benura, venafak
883: Diyyukena deshor, kema deittemar bitren meshichin desitra achara. miyyad vayyar aharon. mahu vayyar aharon. chama desitra achara ittakkaf, miyyad vayyiven mizbeach lefanav, deilmale deakdim uvana mizbeach da, alma ithaddar lecharbana.

Lelistim dehava nafik lekappecha ulekatla bene nasha, chama ligyona demalka, dehahu listim nafak bechela takkif ma avad hahu ligyona, ishtaddal bahade malka lenafka bearcha. umashich leh hahu ligyona behahu archa, ad deazil hahu listim behahu archa, chama diyyukena demalka kaim kammeh, kevan dechama leh lemalka dehava azil kammeh bearcha, miyyad nirta veahdar laachora.

Kacha vayyar aharon distar achara ittakaf, achid beasvavta, veatkif bistar kedusha veshavve leh kameh. kevan dechama sitra bisha diyyukena demalka dekaim kameh, miyyad ahdar laachora, veitchallash tukpeh vecheleh, deha ittakkaf, (miyyad vayyiven mizbeach lefanav) umizbeach da itgabbar, veitchallash sitra achara.

Ta chaze ma ketiv (Shemot 32:5) vayyikra aharon vayyomar chag laAdonai machar. chag laAdonai, vela laegel. velistar kedushsha avad, velistar kedushsha kara veamar. veda asvavta akdim, deilmale deavad da, la kaim alma al kiyyumeh, veim kol da, la shachich rugezeh meaharon, af al gav dela itkavavn levish.

Amar leh kudesha berich hu, aharon, teren charshin illen mashchu lach lemma devau. chayyecha, teren benach yippelun, veal chova da yitpaskun (sefer acher vabechavebaa da yittafsun) hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 9:20) uveaharon hitannaf Adonai meod lehashemido. may lehashemido. illen benoy, kema deat amer (Amos 2:9) vaashmid piryo mimmaal, difri devar nash benoy innun.

Ta chaze, aharon shavve leh lehahu mizbeach lefanav, veeggela tav laachora. benoy shavu listar achara lefanav, usetar kedushsha ahdar laachora, dichtiv, (Vayikra 10:1) vayyakrivu lifne Adonai, lifne Adonai shavu. itpasu bechova da.

Aharon chashav, deven kach yete moshe, veal da hahu mizbeach la satir leh moshe, deillu hava kema dechashvin beni nasha, mila kadmaa deivae lemoshe, lenattetza lehahu mizbeach itzterich, kema denabbe iddo al mizbeach devet el, unevuateh al hahu mizbeach hava. aval hacha mila achara hava kema deittemar. uchetiv, vayyikkach et haeggel asher asu, vela ketiv vayyintotz et hammizbeach.

Ta chaze vayyikra aharon. achriz ihu bekala veamar. ketiv hacha vayyikra vayyomar, uchetiv beyona (Yona 3:4) vayyikra vayyomar, ma lehallan kariz ledina, uf hacha kariz ledina. chag laAdonai machar, nabbe nevua behahu ruach demizbeach, dezammin dina lesharya alayyhu. chag laAdonai, lemebad bechu dina.

Utelat dinin havo, chad, vayyiggof Adonai et haam. vechad, bivne levi. vechad, deashke livne yisrael. vehayeynu chag divne levi. laAdonai, devayiggof Adonai. machar, deashke lon moshe. uvito behahu lelya, ulemachar ishtechachu nefichin umetin. veinnun mayin havo mechashkeshin bimehon kol lelya, uvetzafra ishtechachu metin, veal da chag laAdonai machar. vechol asvata deavad aharon, begin dichtiv vayyiven mizbeach lefanav.

Ta chaze, (hahu mizbeach dikdushsha hava) dichtiv vayyar et haegel umecholot, veillu mizbeach la ketiv. deha aharon minda hava yada, dichtiv, (Shemot 22:19) zoveach laelohim yochoram bilti laAdonai levaddo, vadday ishteziv aharon beeta tava dedavar lenafsheh, vecholla biruta shelim tav, dela itkavvayn levish.

Amar leh ribbi elazar, abba vadday hachi hu, veyisrael la havo. aval yaravam deavad agalin, ha yisrael havo, veegel avdu. amar leh vadday, veukemuha, aval yaravam chata vehechoti, velav kema deamru. devadday chova bisha aved uvammalchut chata.

Amar yaravam, vadday yadana deha setar kedusha la sharya, ella belibba dechol alma, veda yerushalam. ana la yachilna leamshacha lehahu setar hacha, ma abid. miyyad (Melachim 1 12:28) vayyivvaatz hammelech vayyaas vegomer. natal eta bisha, amar ha
884: Sitra achara, deitmashshecha miyyad lechol atar. vekol shekken beara da, detiuvete leashraa begavvay, aval la yachla leitlabbesha ella bediyyukena deshor.

Teren aggalim amay. ella amar yaravam, (sefer acher bemitzrayim uvemadbera) bemadbera havo innun charshin, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 23:20) besar chamorim besaram. (sefer acher laaaynaven mitzrayim ella) hacha, innun teren ruchin bishin, yitlabbeshu kadka chaze lon, dechar venukeba innun. dechar hava bevet el, venukeba havat bedan. umiggo dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) nofet tittofna sifte zara, itmashchu yisrael avatre yattir, dichtiv vayyelchu haam lifne haechad ad dan. ubbegin kach teren agalin havo. umashich lon yaravam beara kaddisha, vahava chova aleh veal yisrael, umana birkan min alma. vealeh ketiv (Mishlei 28:24) gozel aviv veimmo vegomer.

Veal da havo agalin, deha levusha kadmaa demitlabbash sitra achara shor ihu, (191 amud alef) kema deittemar. vei tema amay ihu egel vela shor. ella vadday kach itchaze, vechen vechol sitrin, sheruta dilvusha zuta ihu, veha okimna.

Veal da banay rechimay, kevan deelohim bau, uvistar deelohim itbene ovada, elohim kaddisha, ima, daachidat tadir bidroa demalka, uselikat retzua, la havat tamman, veitzterich leh lemoshe lemeheve tamman beatraha, kevan deankkid leh kudesha berich hu, istakkal.

Telat zimnin ankkid leh, i moshe raya mehemana, kamma chelach takkif, kamma gevuretach rav, telat zimnin ankkid leh, dichtiv veatta hannicha li ha chad. vayyichar appi vahem vaachallem, ha teren. veeese otcha legoy gadol, ha telat. chachmeta demoshe bitlat nekudin illen. achid bidroeh yemina, lokovel hannicha li. achid bidroeh semala, lokovel vayyichar appi vahem vaachallem. itchabbak begufa demalka, lokovel veeese otcha legoy gadol. vechad itchabbak begufa, teren deroin missitra da umissitra da, la yachil leitnanea lesitra bealma. da have chachmeta demoshe, (sefer acher dabemaylay) demini nekudin demalka yada bechol chad minnayyhu, bean atar yittakaf, uvechachmeta avad.

Atu ribbi elazar vechavrayya, venashku yedoy. hava tamman ribbi abba, amar, ilmale la atena lealma ella lemishma da, day lan. bacha veamar, vavy ribbi, kad tistallak mealma, man yanher vigalle nehorin deorayyta. milla da, bachashocha ittemar ad hasheta, denafak mittamman, veha nahir ad rum rekia, uvechurseyya demalka rashim, vekudesha berich hu chadde hasheta behay milla. vechamma chedu al chedu, ittosaf mikkamme malka kaddisha. man yittear mille dechachmeta bealma den kevavtaych.

Ta chaze, ad la chata adam, hava salik vekaim (Bereshit 52 amud bet) bechachma dinhiru illaa, vela hava mitperash meilana dechayye. kevan deasge tiuveta leminda, ulenachta letatta, itmeshich avatrayyhu, ad deitperash meilana dechayye, veyada ra veshavak tov. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim Adonai:Adonai) ki lo el chafetz resha atta lo yegurecha ra, man deitmeshach bera, let leh diyyura im ilana dechayye. vead la chatu, havo shamin kalla milella, veyadin chachmeta illaa, vela dachale. kevan dechatu, afillu kalla diltatta, la havo yachlin lemekam beh.

Kegavvna da, ad la chavu yisrael, beshaata dekayymu yisrael al tura desinay, itavar minnayyhu zuhama dehay chivya, deha keden bitul yetzer hara hava mealma, vedachu leh minnayyhu. ucheden itachidu beilana dechayye, useliku leella, vela nachtu letatta. keden havo yadin, vahavu chaman, aspaklaryan illain, veitnaharan enayyhu, vechaddan leminda ulemishma. ucheden chagar lon kudesha berich hu, chaggirin deatvavn dishma kaddisha, dela yachil leshalletaa alayyhu hay chivya, vela yesaav lon kedibbekadmeta.

Kevan dechatu baegla, itavaru minnayyhu kol innun dargin, unehorin illain, veitavar minnayyhu chagiru mezayyeynin, deitattaru mishshema kaddisha illaa, veamshichu alayyhu chivya bisha kemillekaddemin, vegarimu mota lechol alma. ulevatar ma ketiv. vayyar aharon vechol bene yisrael et moshe vehinne
885: Karan or panav vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv bekadmita, (Shemot 14:31) vayyar yisrael et hayyad haggedola, vechullehu chaman zaharin illain, itnaharin beaspaklarya denahara, dichtiv, (Shemot 20) vechol haam roim et hakkolot. veal yamma, havo chaman vela dachalin, dichtiv ze eli veanvehu, levatar dechatu, pene hassirsur la havo yachle lemechome. ma ketiv, vayyiru miggeshet elav.

Veta chaze, ma ketiv behu (Shemot 33:6) vayyitnatztzelu veni yisrael et edyam (73 amud bet) mehar chorev, deitaveru minnayyhu, innun mezayyeynin deitchabbaru behu betura desinay, begin dela yishlot behu hahu chivya bisha, kevan deitabbar minnayyhu, ma ketiv, umoshe (236) yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachan harechek min hammachane. amar ribbi elazar, may hay kera legabbe hay. ella, kevan deyada moshe, deitavaru minnayyhu deyisrael innun zayynin illain, amar, ha vadday mikkan ulehala, chivya bisha yete ledayyayra benayyhu, vei yekum makdesha hacha benayyhu yisteav, miyyad umoshe yikkach et haohel venata lo michutz lammachane harechek min hammachane. begin dechama moshe, deha keden yishlot chivya bisha, ma dela hava mikkadmat dena.

Vekara lo ohel moed, vechi la hava bekadmita ohel moed. ella, bekadmita ohel setam, hasheta ohel moed. may moed. ribbi elazar amar letav, ribbi abba amar levish, ribbi elazar amar letav, ma moed deihu yom chedva desihara, deittosfa beh kedushsha, la shalta bah pegimuta, uf hacha kare leh bishma da, leachazaa deha itrechik mibbenayyhu, vela itpegim, veal da vekara lo ohel moed ketiv.

Veribbi abba amar levish, deha bekadmita hava ohel setam, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 33:20) ohel bal yitzan bal yissa yetedotav lantzach. vehasheta ohel moed. bekadmita, lemehav chayyin aruchin lealmin, dela yishlot behu mota. mikkan lehalea ohel moed, kema deat amer (Iyov 30:23) uvet moed lechol chay, hasheta, ityeyhiv beh zimna vechayyin ketzuvin lealma. bekadmita la itpegim, vehasheta itpegim. bekadmita chavruta veziuuga lesihara beshimsha, dela yadun. hasheta ohel moed, ziuuga dilhon mizzeman lizman, ubbegin kach vekara lo ohel moed, ma dela hava kodem.

Ribbi shimon, hava yativ lelya chada, velae beorayyta, vahavu yatve kameh ribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak veribbi yose. amar ribbi yehuda, ha ketiv vayyitnatztzelu vene yisrael et edyam mehar chorev. vekaamrenan degarmu mota alayyhu, mehahu zimna uleella, veshalit behu hahu chivya bisha, deade leh minnayyhu bekadmita. yisrael tinach. yehoshua dela chata, itade minneh hahu zayyna illaa dekabbil immehon betura desinay, o la.

I tema dela itade minneh. i hachi, amay mit kishar kol bene nasha. vei tema deitade minneh, amay. veha la chata, deha ihu im moshe hava beshaata dechavu yisrael. vei tema dela kabbil hahu itra betura desinay, kema dekabbilu yisrael. amay.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Tehillim 11:7) ki tzaddik Adonai tzedakot ahev yashar yechozu fanimo, hay kera amru beh chavrayyay ma deamru, aval ki tzaddik Adonai, tzaddik hu, ushemeh tzaddik, ubbegin kach tzedakot ahev. yashar. veihu yashar, kema deat amer (Devarim lak) tzaddik veyashar. veal da yechezu fanemo, kol bene alma, vitaknun archayyhu, lemehach beorach meshar kedka yeot.

Veta chaze, kad dain kudesha berich hu alma, la dan leh ella lefum rubban divne nasha. veta chaze, kad chav adam beilana deachal minneh, garam lehahu ilana, deshare beh mota lechol alma, vegaram pegimu leafresha itteta mibbalah, vekaim chova difgimu da besihara, ad dekayyman yisrael betura desinay, kevan dekayymu yisrael betura
886: Desinay, itabbar hahu pegimu desihara, vekayyeyma leanhara tadir. kevan dechavu yisrael beegla, tavat sihara kemillekaddemin leitpaggema, veshalta chivya bisha, veachid bah, umashich lah legabbeh, veitpegimat.

Vechad yada moshe dechavu yisrael, veitavaru minnayyhu innun zayynin kaddishin, yada vadday, deha chivya achid bah besihara, leamshacha lah legabbeh, veitpegimat. keden appik leh levar. vechevan dekayyeyma leitpaggema, af al gav dihoshua kaim beitra dezayynin dilah, kevan difgimu sharya bah, veithadderat kema deitpegimat bechova deadam, la yachil bar nash leitkayyeyma. bar moshe, dehava shallit bah, umoteh hava bistar achara. veal da la hava reshu bah, lekayyeyma liyhoshua tadir, vela leachara. veal da ohel moed kare leh, deha sharya beh zeman katziv, lechol alma.

Veal da, raza demilla, it yemina leella, veit yemina letatta. it semala leella, veit semala letatta. it yemina leella, bikdushsha illaa. veit yemina letatta, deihu besitra achara. it semala leella bikdushsha illaa, leatara rechimuta, leitkashshera sihara, baatar kaddisha leella, leitnahara.

Veit semala letatta, deafrish rechimuta dilella, veafrish lah milleanhara beshimsha, uleitkarva bahadeh, veda hu sitra dechivya bisha. dechad semala da diltatta itteara, keden mashich lah lesihara, veafrish lah milleella, veitchashshechat nehoraha, veitdabbekat bechivya, ucheden shaivat mota letatta, lecholla deitdabbakat bechivya, veitrachakat meilana dechayye, veal da garim mota lechol alma. veda hu kad isteav makdesha, ad zimna katziv, deittakkanat sihara, vetavat leanhara, veda hu ohel moed.

Veal da yehoshua la mit, ella beeta denachash da, dekariv ufagim mashkena kidkadmeta. veda hu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 33:11) yehoshua bin nun naar. deaf al gav deihu naar letatta, lekabbela nehora, lo yamish mittoch haohel, kema deitpegim da, hachi name itpegim da af al gav dezina kaddisha hava leh, kevan deitpegim sihara, hachi hu vadday la ishteziv bilchodoy minneh, mehahu gavvna mammash, veha ittemar.

Zakkain innun tzaddikayya, deyadin razin deorayyta, umitdabbekin bah beorayyta, umekayyeymin kera dichtiv, (Yehoshua 1:8) vehagita bo yomam valayla vegomer. uveginah yizkun lechayye alma deate, dichtiv, (Devarim 30:20) ki hu chayyecha veorech yamecha vegomer.
887: Al parashat archin, dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 15:2) asher sam lo badderech baaloto mimmitzrayim. kamin hava leella, lesoova makdesha. vechamin hava letatta, lesaava leyisrael. menalan, dichtiv (Devarim 25:18) asher karcha badderech. ketiv hacha asher karcha, uchetiv hatam (Devarim 23:11) ki yihye vecha ish asher la tahor mikre layla.

Val da bevilam ketiv, (Bamidbar 23:4) vayyikkar elohim el bilam. vayyikkar lishana dimsaava nakat. vei tema, ha ketiv elohim. ella kudesha berich hu azmin leh hahu atar dimsaava, leistaava beh, behahu darga deihu itdabbak leistaava beh. ma avad bilam. ihu chashiv beinnun karbanin lesalleka leella, miyyad zamin leh kudesha berich hu hahu atar. amar leh ha misavu legabbach, kema deitchaze lach, veal da vayyikkar elohim el bilam.

Kegavvna da asher karcha badderech vegomer. azmin legabbach hahu chivya bisha leella, lesaava lecha bechol sitrin. veilmale deittakkaf moshe leella, vihoshua letatta, la yachilu yisrael leh. uvegin kach, natir kudesha berich hu hahu devavu, ledare darin. may tama. begin dechashiv leakera at kayyayma meatreh. uvegin kach pakadti, bifkidda, deha tamman (vayyetze 159 amud bet) itremiz raza deat kayyayma kaddisha.

Ta chaze, ma ketiv, vayyomer shaul el hakkeni. man keni. da yitro. vechi man yahiv bene yitro hacha, lemehve diyyurehon baamalek, veha biricho havo sharyayn. ella ha ketiv, (Shoftim 1:16) uvene keni choten moshe alu meir hattemarim et bene yehuda midbar yehuda vegomer. vechad alu mittamman, sharu bitchuma daamalek, ad hahu zimna deata shaul malka, dichtiv vayyasar keni mittoch amalek.

Begin deha bezimna dechayyayvayya ishtechachu, (nusach acher itanashu) innun chaside vezakkae demishtachchin benayyhu, mittafsan bechovehon, veha ukemuha. kegavvna da, ilmale hahu irbuveya deitchabbaru behu beyisrael, la itanashu yisrael, al ovada deegla.

Veta chaze ma ketiv (197, 224 amud alef) bekadmita, (Shemot 25:2) meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo, leachlela kolla, begin devaa kudesha berich hu lemebad ovada demashkena mikkol sitrin, bemocha ukelifa. uvegin dahavo innun erev rav begavvavyyhu, ittemar meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo, leachlela lon benayyhu deyisrael, deinnun mocha. vechullehu itpekadu.

Levatar sata zina lezineh, veatu innun erev rav veavadu yat egla, vesatu avatrayyhu innun demitu, vegarmu lon leyisrael mota vekatola. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala ovada demashkena la yehe, ella (197 amud alef) missitra deyisrael bilchodayyhu. miyyad vayyakhel moshe et kol adat beni yisrael vegomer. uchetiv batreh kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. meittechem vadday, vela kekadmita dichtiv, meet kol ish asher yiddevennu libbo. vayyakhel moshe vegomer, mean atar kanish lon. ella begin dahavo innun erev rav benayyhu, itzterich moshe leachnasha lon, uleyachada lon mibbenayyhu.

(Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe. ribbi abba patach, (Devarim 31:12) hakehel et haam haanashim vehannashim vehattaf. ma lehallan kelala dechullehu yisrael, uf hacha kelala dechullehu yisrael, uman innun. shittin ribbo.

Ribbi elazar patach kera beyisrael, kad nachit moshe min tura desinay, dichtiv, (Shemot 32:17) vayyishma yehoshua et kol haam bereo vayyomer el moshe kol milchama bammachane. vayyishma yehoshua, vechi yehoshua shama, umoshe la shama. ella vadday, ad hasheta yehoshua la hava yada, umoshe hava yada. i hachi mahu bereo. ella bereo baAdonai ketiv, dehahu kalla besitra achara hava. vihoshua dehava anpoy desihara, istakkal behahu kala, dehava desitra deraa, miyyad vayyomer el moshe kol milchama bammachan.
Behahi shaata itbaru teren luche avna dahavo bekadmita. veha okimna, deinnun ityaykaru al yedoy
888: Venaflu veitbaru. may tama. begin defarchu atvavn miggo luche avanin. (81 amud alef, Vayikra 76)

Ta chaze, bed tekufin deshatta, kala ittear, bed sitrin dealma, behahu kalla ittearuta desitra achara ittear beh. vehahu ittearuta desitra achara al ben kalla lekala, veitchashach nehora bekala diltatta. begin dela mata nehora dekala dilella, lekala diltatta, keden akdim hahu ittearuta, veal ben da leda nachash dimfatte leitteta, venatil nehora. vehahu kala, hu kol milchama, kol raa. veda ihu bereo.

Veal da shama yehoshua vela moshe, begin denatal hahu raa nehora desihara dehava achid bah yehoshua. umoshe dehava achid beshimsha, la shama. veyisrael kullehu itchashach nehora dilhon, begin hahu raa deitdabbekat behu. kevan demachal kudesha berich hu chovehon, keden vayyakhel moshe et kol adat bene yisrael vayyomer alehem elle haddevarim vegomer, deha hahu erev rav itabbar minnayyhu.

Ribbi elazar veribbi yose havo yatve lelya chad, veka mitaske beorayyta, ad la itpelig lelya. addehachi kara gavra, berichu birchata, (amar leh rabbi elazar, hasheta hu zimna dekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden leishtashea im tzadikaya, amar leh rabbi yose, amay mishtaasha kudesha behach hu) bacha ribbi elazar veamar, ta chaze, ad hasheta kudesha berich hu izdaza, telat mea vetishin rekiin, uvatash behu, uvacha al charban be makdesha, veorid teren (19 amud bet) dimin lego yamma rabba, veadkar livnohi miggo bichya.

Begin delitlat sitrin itpelag lelya, bitresar shate dahavo reshimin beh, vei ittosfan shate belelya, innun shate demittosfan, dimama innun, vela itchashivu milelya, bar teresar deinnun dile. veinnun teresar, itpelagu litlat sitrin, (zohar Rut 26 amud alef) utelat mashiryayn demalachin kaddishin, itpelagu (sefer acher itmenun) beinnun telat sitrin.

Mashshiryay kadmaa, itmanna bed shate kamayyta, desheruta delelya, leshabbecha lemarehon, uma kaamre. (Tehillim 24:3) laAdonai haaretz umeloah vegomer, ki hu al yamim yesadah vegomer, mi yaale vehar Adonai vegomer, neki chappayim uvar levav vegomer. may tama da. begin dechad lelya paris gadpoy al alma, keden, kol bene alma taamin taama demota, venafke nishmatayyhu lesalleka leella, veinnun malachin kayymin veka amre, mi yaale vehar Adonai. har Adonai, da har habbayit. mekom kadsho, da azarat yisrael. kegavvna dilella, hachi name letatta.

Begin divchol rekia urekia, kamma memanan, uchemma sarchin kayymin tamman. vechad nishmatin nafkin, baan lesalleka leella, vei la zachyayn innun dachyayn lon levar, veazlin veshatin bealma, venatlin lon kama chavile tehirin, veodin lon millin kedivan, ulezimnin millin dikshot, mimma deate lizman (252 amud bet) kariv, kema deukemuha.

Veinnun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, azlin veshatan leella, ufatchin lon pitchin, vesallekin lon lego hahu atar deikre har Adonai, kegavvna deraza dehar habbayit letatta. umittamman alin lego hahu atar deikre mekom kadsho. detamman itchazyayn kol nishmatin lekame marehon. kegavvna da hahu atar, deitchazun yisrael kamme kudesha berich hu, atar deikre azarat yisrael. beshaata denishmatin kayymin tamman, keden chedva demarihon, leittakna behu atar, deikre kodesh (258 amud bet) hakkadashim. vetamman reshimin kol ovadehon vezachvavn dilhon.
Mashshiryay tinyayna, itmanna bearba shate acharanin, vela amre shirata, bar tere shate, ad deitpelag lelya, veal kudesha berich hu beginta deeden.

Veillen innun avele tziyyon, veinnun devachu al charban be makdesha. uvesheruta dearba shate emtzaayyan, patche veamre, (Tehillim 137:1) al naharot bavel sham yashavnu gam bachinu vegomer, veillen innun devachu al naharot bavel, immehon deyisrael,
889: Mimmashma dichtiv gam bachinu. umenalan devachu tamman. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 33:7) hen erellam tzaaku chutza. mahu chutza. da bavel, begin dechullehu ozfuha lishchina ad bavel. vetamman bachu immehon deyisrael. veal da patche behay, umesayyeyme zechor Adonai livni edom vegomer.

Keden ittear kudesha berich hu bedargoy, uvatash birkiin kidamaran, veizdaazau teresar alfe almin, vegae uvache, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 25:30) Adonai mimmarom yishag umimmeon kadsho yitten kolo shaog yishag al navihu, veadkar lon leyisrael, veachit teren dimin lego yamma rabba. ucheden ittear shalhovita chad devistar tzafon, uvatash rucha chad devistar tzafon behahu shalhovita, veazla veshaata bealma, vehahi shaata itpelag lelya, veshalhovita azla uvatash begadfoy detarnegola, vekare, keden kudesha berich hu al beginta deeden.

Vekudesha berich hu let leh nayycha ad deal leginta deeden leishtashea benishmatehon detzaddikayyay. vesiman (Ester 7:4) ki nimkarnu ani veammi vegomer. vayyomer hammelech mi hu ze vegomer, vehammelech kam bachamato mimmishte hayyayin el ginnat habbitan vegomer.

Beshaata dekudesha berich hu al beginta deeden, keden kol innun ilanin deginta, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, patche veamre, (Tehillim 24:7) seu shearim rashechem vegomer. mi ze melech hakkavod vegomer. seu shearim rashechem vegomer. uveshaata denishmathon detzaddikayyay di beara ahadru legufayyhu, keden atkifu behu kol innun malachin, veamre (Tehillim 134:1) hinne barchu et Adonai kol avde Adonai. veolifna deda mashshiryay telitaa ka amre da, bearba shate batrayyta.

Vekaamre shirata, ad desalik nehora detzafra, dichden meshabbechin lemarehon kol innun kochavaya umazzale, vechol innun malachin illain, di shultanehon bimama, kullehu meshabbechan lemarihon, veamre shirata. hada hu dichtiv, (Iyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim.

Beshaata deshimsha nafik, bimama, yisrael natle shirata letatta, veshimsha leella, dichtiv, (Tehillim 72:5) yiraucha im shamesh. beshaata denatil shimsha begalgeloy, patach kal neimuta, veamar shirata. umay shirata kaamre. (Tehillim 105:1) hodu laAdonai kiru vishmo vegomer. (Tehillim 105:1) shiru lo zammeru lo vegomer. veyisrael meshabbechan lekudesha berich hu bimama, im shimsha. hada hu dichtiv yiraucha im shamesh, veaf al gav deha okimna lehay kera, amar ribbi elazar, ilmale divne alma atimin libba usetimin ayynin la yachlin lemekam mikkal neimuta degalgala deshimsha, kad natil (venafik) umeshabbach kame kudesha berich hu.

Addehachi deitasseku beorayyta, nahar yemama. kamu veatu lekameh derabbi shimon, kevan dechama lon, amar rabbi shimon, elazar beri, ant vechavrayyay astimu garmayychu illen telat yomin, dela tifkun levar begin demalach hammavet ishtechach bemata, veit leh reshu lechabbela, vechevan deityeyhiv leh reshu lechabbela, yachil lechabbela, lechol man deitchaze kameh.
Vetu devar nash deitchaze kammeh, salik veaste aleh, veadkar chovoy, uvae dina mikkamme kudesha berich hu, vela itade mittamman, ad deittedan hahu bar nash, veityeyhiv leh reshu vekatil leh.

Amar rabbi shimon, haelohim, rubba dealma, la mitu, ad la mata zimnayyhu, bar dela yade leistammera garmayyhu, deha beshaata demita afke leh mibbeteh leve kivre, malach hammavet ishtechach bene neshe, amay bene neshe. dehachi (227 amud alef) hu orchoy, miyyoma defatte lechavva, uveginah garim mota lechol alma. veal da (24) katil bar nash, veguvere ishtechachu im mita, al bene neshe bearcha.

Veit leh reshu, lemiktal bene nasha, veistakkal beanpayyhu bearcha deitchaziu kammeh, mishaata demafke leh mibbeteh leve kivre, ad deahadru levetayyeyhu uveginehon garim mota lechamma guverin bealma, ad la mata zimnayyhu. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei 13:23) veyesh nispe belo mishpat. begin desalik veastin, veadkar chovoy devar nash kamme kudesha berich hu, veitdan al innun chovin veistallak ad la mata zimneh.
May takante. beshaata denatle meta leve kivre, yehdar bar nash
890: Anpoy veyyishbok lenashe batar katpoy. vei innun mekaddeme, yehach laachora, begin dela yitchaze immehon anpin beanpin. ulevatar dimhadre mibbe kivre, la yehdar behahu archa denashe kayyman, vela yistakkal behu kelal, ella yiste bearcha achara. uvegin divne nasha la yade, vela mistakkelin da rubba dealma, itdanu bedina, veistallaku ad la mata zimnayyhu.
Amar ribbi elazar, i hachi, tav leh levar nash dela yozif lemita. amar leh la. deha bar nash deistamar kehay gavvna, itchaze learka deyomin, vechol shekken lealma deate.

Ta chaze, lav lemaggana atkinu kadmae shofar, leamshacha mita min beta leve kivre. i tema deal meta viyykara dileh lechud ihu. la. ella, begin leaggana al chayyay, dela yishlot alayyhu malach hammavet, leastaa leella veyistamrun minneh.

Patach veamar, (Bamidbar 10:9) vechi tavou milchama beartzechem al hatztzar hatztzorer etchem vegomer, vedayyikna al hatztzar, da malach hammavt. hatztzorer etchem tadir, vekatil livne nasha, (veaik lon lechayye) uvae lekatla acharanin. may takanteh. vahareotem. im berosh hashshana, dehu yoma dedina leella, hay malach hammavet nachit letatta, begin leashgacha beovadin divne nasha, ulesalleka leella leastaa lon. veyisrael deyade deha malach hammavet nachit letatta vesalik leella, begin lemehve kategora alayyhu. mekaddeme bashshofar leyabbeva aleh, dela yachil lon uleaggana alayyhu.

Vechol shekken beshaata deavid dina vekatil bene nasha, veishtechach letatta. vechol shekken beshaata deazle leve kivre, veahadru mibbe kivre, deha beshaata denashe natle raglayyhu im mita, ihu nachit veishtechach kamayyhu, dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:Adonai) ragleha yordot mavet, yordot leman. lehahu atar deikre mavet. veal da chavva garmat mota lechol alma, rachamana lishezvinan.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Mishlei 30:20) ken derech ishsha menaafet vegomer. veha okimna. aval ken derech ishsha menaafet, da hu malach hammavet, vehachi hu, vehachi ikre. achla umachata fiha, okidat alma beshalhovoy, vekatlat bene nasha ad la mata zimnayyhu, veamra lo faalti aven, deha dina baa alayyhu, veishtechachu bechovin, uvedina keshot mitu.

Beshaata deavdu yisrael yat egla, umitu kol innun uchelosin, hava malach hammavet ishtechach bene neshe, bego mashiryyayta deyisrael. kevan deistakkal moshe, deha malach hammavet ishtechach beni neshe, umashiryyayta deyisrael benayyhu, miyyad kanish lechol guverin lechodayyhu, hada hu dichtiv vayyakhel moshe et kol adat bene yisrael. illen guverin, dechanish lon veafrish lon lechodayyhu.

Umalacha hammavet la hava mitperash miggo nashin, ad deittokam mashkena, dichtiv vayyakem moshe et hammishkan. vaafillu beshaata denashin havo mayytin nedava lemashkena, la hava mitade mibbenayyhu, ad dechama moshe, veyahav leguverin eta, dela yiyitun bechibbura chada immehon, vela yitchazun anpin beanpin, ella levatar kitpayyhu. hada hu dichtiv vayavou haanashim al hannashim (nusach acher veyavou haanashim al hannashim lo ketiv, ella veyavou al) vayyaviu la ketiv, ella vayyavou bearcha chada la havo azlin, ella levatar katpayyhu. begin demalach hammavet la itperash mibbenayyhu ad deittokam mashkena.

Ta chaze, la ishtechach bene neshe, pachut mishsheva nashim, vela pachut meeser. uvearcha beitgalleya, besheva ishtechach, uvae dina. beeser, aste lekatla. uvegin deishtechach benayyhu bearcha beitgalleya, ketiv vayyavou haanashim al hannashim. veistemaru kol hahu yoma kullehu chavrayyay, veishtaddalu beorayyta.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Bereshit 7:1) vayyomer Adonai el noach bo atta vechol betcha el hatteva. hay kera okimna, aval ta chaze, vechi la yachil kudesha berich hu lenatra leh lenoach, beatar chad bealma. diyhe
891: Mabbul bechol alma, vela yehe behahu atar, kema dichtiv begidon, (Shoftim 6:40) vayhi chorev el hagizza levaddah. o lenatra leh beara deyisrael, dichtiv bah, (Yechezkel 22:24) la gushmah beyom zaam, dela nachtu alah mi tofana.

Ella, kevan dimchabbela nachat lealma, man dela sagir garmeh, veishtechach kameh beitgalyay, itchayyayv benafsheh, deihu katil garmeh. mena lan. milot, dichtiv, (Bereshit 19:17) himmalet al nafshecha al tabbit acharecha. may taama al tabbit acharecha. begin dimchabbela azil batar katpoy, vei ahadar resheh, veistakkal beh anpin beanpin, yachil lenazka leh.

Veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 7) vayisgor Adonai baado. dela yitchaze kamme mechabbela, velo yishlot aleh malach hammavet. vead dehavu temirin, mitu telesar guverin bemata. amar ribbi shimon, berich rachamana, dela istakkal bediyyukenayychu malach hammavet.

(Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe vegomer. (195 amud alef) ahadar lon kemillekaddemin, ovada demashkena. amar ribbi chiyyay, kolla kema deittemar. veovada demashkena la itavid ella miyisrael bilchodayyhu, vela meinnun erev rav, begin deinnun erev rav amshichu leh lemalach hammavet lenachta lealma. kevan deistakkal moshe beh, ashde leinnun erev rav, levar, vechanish lon leyisrael bilchodayyhu, hada hu dichtiv vayyakhel moshe vegomer.

Ribbi shimon patach, (Mishlei 30:4) mi ala shamayim vayyerad mi asaf ruach bechafnav mi tzarar mayim bassimla mi hekim kol afse aretz ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda. hay kera ha okimna, vechamma samchin it beh. vecholla bekudesha berich hu ittemar, deihu kolla. (79 amud alef) veittemar, ma shemo uma shem beno ki teda, da kudesha berich hu. ma shemo Adonai. uma shem beno, yisrael dichtiv, (Shemot 4) beni bechori yisrael, veha okimna. mi ala shamayim. ha ukemuha, da moshe, dichtiv, (Shemot 24:1) veel moshe amar ale el Adonai.

Davar acher mi ala shamayim, da eliyyahu, dichtiv beh (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayim. vechi hech yachil eliyyahu lesalleka lashshamayim. veha kullehu shamayim, la yachlin lemisbal, afillu garina kechardal miggufa dehay alma, veat amart vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayim.

Ella kema deat amar, (Shemot 19:11) vayyered Adonai al har sinay. uchetiv (Shemot 24:18) vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar. vechi kudesha berich hu dehava betura desinay, uchetiv (Shemot 24:17) umare kevod Adonai kaesh ochelet berosh hahar, ech yachil moshe lesalleka legabbeh. ella bemoshe ketiv, vayyavo moshe betoch heanan vayyaal el hahar. deal go anana, keman deitlabbash bilvusha. hachi name itlabbash baanana, veal begavveh. uveanana itkeriv legabbe eshsha, veyachil lemikrav. uf hachi eliyyahu, dichtiv vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayim, deal behahi seara, veitlabbash beh behahi seara, vesalik leella.

Veraza ashkachna, besifra deadam kadmaa, deamar beinnun toldot dealma, rucha chada yehe deyyechot lealma beara, veyitlabbash begufa, veeliyyahu shemeh. uvehahu gufa yistalak, veishtelil migufeh, veyishtear bassoara. vegufa dinhora achara yizdaman leh, lemehve go malache. vechad yechut, yitlabbash behahu gufa, deyishtear behahu alma, uvehahu gufa yitchaze letatta, uvegufa achara yitchaze leella. veda ihu raza, demi ala shamayim vayyerad. la hava bar nash desalik lishmayya rucha dileh, venachit levatar letatta, bar eliyyahu, deihu salik leella venachit letatta.

Davar acher mi ala shamayim, da eliyyahu. vayyerad, da yona, denachat leh nuna go tehome, leimke yamma. yona mechela deeliyyahu ka ata, eliyyahu salik, yona nachit, da shail nafsheh lememat, veda shail nafsheh lememat, uvegin kach ikre ben amittay. uchetiv, (Melachim 1 17:24) udevar Adonai beficha emet.
Mi tzarar mayim, da eliyyahu, detztzarir tzerora demayya bealma, vela nachtu talla umitra dishmayya. bassimla, da eliyyahu, dehava (nusach acher mache aderateyh) mayyte
892: Addarteh lemebad nissin. mi asaf ruach bechafnav, da eliyyahu, deahadar rucha devar nash lego meoy. (asaf kema deat amar 0 veasaf hammetzora).

Mi hekim kol afse aretz. da eliyyahu, dilvatar detzarar mayim, veome al (sefer acher 250) shemaya levatar ahaddar bitzloteh, veokim kol alma, venachit mitra, veityehiv mezona lecholla. ma shemo, da eliyyahu. uma shem beno, da eliyyahu. ma shemo, kad salik leella, eliyyahu. uma shem beno, kad nachit letatta, veitavid shelicha lemebad nissin, eliyyahu shemeh.

Davar acher mi ala shamayim, da kudesha berich hu, kema deokimna. veraza demilla, mi, veha okimna. vehacha ihu raza dirticha illaa, (23 amud bet) arba sitrin dealma, deinnun yesode kadmae decholla, vechullehu talyayn behahu atar illaa deikre mi, kema deittemar.

Ta chaze, kad kayyeyma shaata diruta kamme kudesha berich hu, leyachada reticha illaa (sefer acher birticha 806) lemehve kolla chad. keden kala nafik, mehahu atar illaa kaddisha, deikre shamayim, vechanish kol illen kaddishin diltatta, vechol innun ravrevan kaddishin, umashiryayn illain, lemeheve kullehu zeminin kachada, hada hu dichtiv, vayyakhel moshe, da raza deshamayim. et kol adat bene yisrael, illen innun teresar mashiryayn illain kaddishin.
Vayyomer alehem. umay kaamar ze haddavar vegomer, kechu meittechem teruma, ittakanu kullechun, lesalleka alayychu, ulemetal alayychu, yekara dechurseyay kaddisha, lesalleka leella.

Afrishu minnayychu innun yakkirin, innun ravrevin illain, lesalleka lehahi teruma, raza dechurseyay kaddisha, leitchabbera baavahan, (nusach acher bevalah) deha matronita la itchaze lemete levalah, ella beinnun betuletan ulemtaha, deyetun immah, umedabberan lah, ad dematat levalah, kema deat amar, (Tehillim 45:15) betulot achareha reuteh vegomer, vechol kach lamma, lemete leitchabbera bevalah.

(Shemot 35:5) kol nediv libbo, illen innun arba mashiryayn illain, devichlala dilhon kelilan, kol innun shear mashiryayn, veillen innun denafkan baavahan illain, deikrun nedivim. kema (Vayikra 19 amud bet, 24 amud alef, 150 amud bet) deukemuha, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 21:18) karuha nedive haam, illen avahan.

Yevieha, yeviuha la ketiv, ella yevieha, leyachada kolla kachada. vechen yavi la ketiv, ella yevieha, lesalleka lah legabbe balah bikara, kema deitzterich. et terumat Adonai, et leasgaa, kol innun mashiryayn illain acharanin, leitchabbera kolla kachada, veinnun teresar bichlala chada. zahav. vachesef. unechoshet. techelet. veargaman. vetolaat shani. veshesh veizzim. veorot elim meaddamim. veorot techashim. vaatze shittim. veshemen lammaor. uvesamim leshemen hammishcha. veliktoret hassammim. illen innun teresar mashiryayn illain, dichlilan kullehu kachada bichlala dearba deikrun chayot hakkodesh kema deittemar.

Vechullehu illen sallekin lechurseyay kaddisha, leaala lah leella, leitchabbera bevalah, begin lemeheve kolla chad, begin deyishtechach immah bikara illaa. keden yativ malka illaa al kuresyyay kaddisha, veitchabbera itteta bevalah, lemehve kolla chad. ucheden, ihu chedvavta decholla.

Ta chaze, hacha share lemimne zahav bekadmita, vechesef levatar, begin dehay cheshbona mittatta. aval kad ate lemimne mechushebana dirticha dilella, share lemimni mimina bekadmita, ulevatar min semala. menalan. dichtiv, (Chagai 2:8) li hakkesef veli hazzahav. kesef bekadmita, ulevatar hazzahav. uvirticha diltatta, sharu missemala ulevatar mimina, dichtiv zahav vachesef unechoshet. zahav bekadmita, ulevatar kesef.

Vechol innun retichin ikrun nediv lev. kol: leachlela kol shear retichin. lev. may lev. hayeynu raza dichtiv, (Mishlei 15:15) vetov lev mishte tamid. veda ihu libba decholla, veda kurseyay kaddisha. veal da ikrun
893: Lev. kol nediv lev, kema deokimna, dearba mashiryayn illen, kelala dechullehu ikrun beraza chada, nediv lev. terumat Adonai, da kurseyay kaddisha. uvegin dearimu lah leella, vesallekin lah leella, ikre terumat Adonai.
Veal da, kad chama yechezkel raza dechayyot, dahavo sallekin, la chama mahu desallekin, begin deihi salleka legabbe malka illaa bignizu bitmira bikara illaa.

(Shemot 35:10) vechol chacham lev vachem, illen innun shittin mekorin, deashkeyay alma, uminnehon itshake. yavou, amay yavou. ella deyetun leminkat meim genaza dechayyin. yavou, ulevatar vayyaasu ma dekudesha berich hu pakid lon leahanaa alma.

(Shemot 35:5) kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. ribbi yehuda patach, (Yeshayahu 58:7) halo faros laraev lachmecha vegomer. ta chaze, zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, kad miskena ira legabbeh. dehahu miskena dorona dekudesha berich hu hve, deshadar leh. man dimkabbel leh lehahu dorona besever anpin, zakkaa chulakeh.

Ta chaze, man dechayis lemiskena, veativ leh nafsheh, kudesha berich hu salik aleh, keillu hu bara lenafsheh. veal da avraham dehava chayis lechol beni alma, salik aleh kudesha berich hu, keillu hu bara lon, dichtiv, (Bereshit 12:5) veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan.

Veaf al gav deha okimna halo faros, may faros, lemifras leh mappa benahama umezona lemechal. davar acher halo faros, kema deat amer (Daniel Adonai:28) peres perisat vegomer. devae lemifras perisin denahama kameh, begin dela lichsif. veyafros kameh beena tava. lachmecha, lechem la ketiv, ella lachmecha. hahu dilach mimmamonecha, vela digzilu, vela daashak, vela digneva. dei hachi, lav zechuta hu, ella vavy leh, deate leadkera chovoy. kegavvna da kechu meittechem teruma, learama mimma dilchon, vela meoshek, vela miggezel, vela miggeneva, veha ukemuha.

Ribbi chiyyay veribbi yitzchak veribbi yose, havo azle bearcha, ad dahavo azle, paga behu ribbi abba. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday shechinta bahadan. kad mata legabbayyhu, amar ribbi abba, ketiv, (Melachim 1 8:16) min hayyom asher hotzeti et ammi et yisrael mimmitzrayim lo vacharti veir mikkol shivte yisrael vaevchar bedavid vegomer livnot bayit lihyot shemi sham. hay kera, lav resheh sefeh, velav sefeh resheh, dichtiv lo vacharti beir, vaevchar bedavid, may hay im hay. vaevchar biyrushala 40 mibbae leh.

Ella kad kudesha berich hu it reuta kammeh lemivni karta, istakkol bekadmita, behahu resha denahig amma dekarta, ulevatar beni karta, veayyte leamma beh. hada hu dichtiv lo vacharti beir, ad deistakkalna bedavid, lemehve raya al yisrael. begin demata vechol beni mata, kullehu kayymin beraayya denahig leamma, i raya ihu tava, tav leh, tav lemata, tav leamma. vei raya ihu bisha, vavy leh, vavy lemata vavy leamma. vehasheta istakkol kudesha berich hu bealma, vesalik biruteh lemivne leh, veokim beresha ledavid, hada hu dichtiv vaevchar bedavid avdi. (sefer acher veokim beresha dedara lerabbi shimon vechavreh lemekam kammeh)

Milleta chadta shemana. patach veamar, (Tehillim 146:5) ashre sheel yaakov beezzero sivro al Adonai elohav. vechi el yaakov, vela el avraham, vela el yitzchak, ella el yaakov. begin deyaakov la itrechitz baavohi, vela beimeh, kad arak kamme achuy, veazal yechiday, bela mamona, kema deat amer (Bereshit 32:11) ki vemakli avarti et hayyarden hazze, veihu itrechitz beh bekudesha berich hu, dichtiv, (sham 28) im yihye elohim immadi ushemarani vegomer. vecholla shail mikkammeh dekudesha berich hu, veyahav leh.

Sivro al Adonai elohav. sivro, vela amar tikvato, vela bitchono, ella sivro. al tikre sivro, ella shivro. denicha lehu letzaddikayyay, letavra garmayyhu, uleitbera teviru al teviru, vecholla al Adonai elohav. kema deat amer, (tehillim ma) ki alecha horagnu chol
894: Kegavvna deyaakov, dichtiv vayyar yaakov ki yesh shever bemitzrayim, deha teviru degaluta, chama dehava leh bemitzrayim, veshavve tukepeh bekudesha berich hu. uvenoy deyaakov savlu teviru degaluta, vela ishtannu miggo raza dimhemnuta deavahathon ushema dekudesha berich hu hava begaluta regila befumayyhu.

Veal da ketiv bemoshe, (Shemot 3) veamru li meAdonai shemo meAdonai. begin dahavo yade leh, vela anshu leh lealmin, vesavlu teviru degaluta al kudesha berich hu, uvegin kach zache lefurekanin ulenisin uleatvvavn saggiin.

Veattun kaddishin elyonin, desavllin teviru degufa meatar leatar al kudesha berich hu, al achat kamma vechamma dezakkain attun lemebad lechu nissin ufurekanin, vetizkun lechayye alma deate. azlu kullehu kachada.

Patach veamar (Shemot 35:5) kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai kol nediv libbo yevieha vegomer. ta chaze, beshaata devar nash shavve reuteh, legabbe pulechana demareh, hahu reuta salik bekadmita al libba, deihu kiuma visoda dechol gufa. levatar salik hahu reuta tava, al kol shayyfe gufa. ureuta dechol shayyfe gufa, ureuta delibba, mitchabberan kachada, veinnun mashchin alayyhu zihara dishchinta ledayyeyra immehon, vehahu bar nash ihu chulaka dekudesha berich hu heve, hada hu dichtiv kechu meittechem teruma. meittechem hava amshechuta, lekabbela alayychu hahi teruma, lemeheve chulaka laAdonai.

Vei tema delav birshuteh debar nash kayyayma milla. ta chaze, ma ketiv kol nediv libbo yevieha et terumat Adonai. kol nediv libbo vadday, man deyitree libbeh, yamshich lah lishchinta legabbeh. hada hu dichtiv yevieha, af al gav deihi beistallekuta leella, yevieha meatar illaa, leamshacha ledayyeyra immeh.

Vechad tete leashraa immeh, kama birkan vechamma utra tete imme. hada hu dichtiv zahav vachesef unechoshet. la yechsar leh kol utra dealma. da lishar bene alma. aval attun kaddishin elyonin, kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. amar ribbi chiyyay, man deshare learama, hu yarim.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, (Yona 2) vayyomer Adonai laddag vegomer, vechi bean atar amar leh. ella beshaata devara kudesha berich hu alma beovada divreshit, beyoma chamishaa bara nune yamma. keden pakid veamar, diyyehe zamin chad nuna lemivla leyona, viyyehe bemeoy telata yomin utelat lelavavn, ulevatar deyyirme leh levar.

Vela da bilchodoy, ella kol ma deavad kudesha berich hu beovada divreshit, becholla atne immeh. beyoma kadmaa bara shemaya, atne immehon diysalik leeliyyahu hashshamayma bego seara, vechen hava, dichtiv, (Melachim 2 2:11) vayyaal eliyyahu bassoara hashshamayim. behahu yoma bara nehora, veatni immeh deyachshich leshimmesha bemitzrayim telata yomin, dichtiv, (Shemot 10:22) vayhi choshech afela bechol eretz mitzrayim sheloshet yamim.

Beyoma tinyayna bara rekia, dihe mafrish ben mayya lemayya, kedichtiv (Bereshit 1:6) vayyomer elohim yehi rakia betoch hammayim vayhi mavdil ben mayim lamayim. veatni immehon kudesha berich hu, demayya yehon mafrishin leyisrael ben tumea letohora, leitdakkea behu, vechach hava.

Beyoma telitaa appik ara miggo mayya, veachnnish lemayya, vaavad mehahu kenishu deitkenashu leatar chad, yamma. veatne beyamma lemebar leyisrael begavveh beyabbeshta, ulemitba lemitzrae, vechach hava, dichtiv, (Shemot 14:27) vayyashav hayyam lifnot boker leetano. al tikre leetano, ella litnao, lemma deatni immeh kudesha berich hu, beovada divreshit. tu atne beara, detiftach yat pumaha bemachlekota dekorach, vetivla lekorach ulechol kenishateh, vechach hava, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 16:32) vattiftach haaretz et fiha vetivla otam veet korach.
Beyoma reviaa, bara shimsha vesihara, dichtiv yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim, veatne im shimsha, lemehve kaim befalgu shemayya beyome dihoshua,
895: Dichtiv, (Yehoshua 10 12) vayyaamod hashshemesh bachatzi hashshamayim. atni bechochavayya lemebad kerava besisra, dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:20) hakkochavim mimmesillotam nilchamu im sisra.

Beyoma chamishaa bara nune yamma, veofe dishmayya, atni beofe lemezan orvim leeliyyahu, bezimna deatzar lishmayya, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:4) veet haorvim tzivviti lechalkelcha sham. tzivviti dayyka. veatne benune yamma leizdammena nuna chad, lemivla leh leyona, uleashdaa leh levar.

Beyoma shetitaa bara leadam, veatne immeh, detippok minneh itteta, detezun leeliyyahu, dichtiv, (Melachim 1 17:9) hinne tzivviti sham isha almana lechalkelecha. hinne tzivviti, miyyoma deitbere alma. vechen bechol ovada veovada deitchaddesh bealma, kudesha berich hu pakid hahu ovada miyyoma deitbere alma. uf hacha, vayyomer Adonai laddag. vayyomer, mishshit yomin divrishit kaamar leh.

Hacha it lan semech bealma, al ovadin divne nasha behay alma. yona denachat lassefina, da ihi nishmeta devar nash, denachta lehay alma lemeheve begufa debar nash. amay itkere yona. begin dechevan deishtetafat begufa, keden ihi yona behay alma. kema deittemar, (Vayikra 25:17) vela tonu ish et amito. ucheden bar nash azil behay alma, kassefina bego yamma rabba, dachashivat leittabbera, kema deat amer (Yona 1:4) vehooniyya chishsheva lehishshaver.

Uvar nash kad ihu behay alma chate, vechashiv dearak mikkamme mareh. vela ashgach behahu alma. ucheden attil kudesha berich hu ruach seara takkifa. da ihi gezerat dina, dekayyeyma tadir kame kudesha berich hu. uvaat dina devar nash mikkamme, veda ihu deka mate lassefina, veadkar chovoy devar nash leittafsa leh.

Kevan deitpas bar nash al yeda dehahi seara beve mareh, ma ketiv veyona yarad el yarkete hassefina vayyishkav vayyeradam. af al gav devar nash beve mareh, nishmeta la ittearat leatava kamme mareh, lemifrak chovoy. ma ketiv, vayyikrav elav rav hachovel. man rav hachovel. da yetzer tov, deihu manhig kolla. vayyomer lo ma lecha nirdam kum kera el elohecha vegomer. lav shaata hu lemiddemach, deha sallekin lach ledina, al kol ma deavdat behay alma, tuv mechovach.

Istakkol bemillin illen, vetuv lemarach. ma melachtecha deat askat bah behay alma, veode alah kame marach. umeayin tavo, istakkal meayin beat, mittippa serucha, vela titgae kammeh. ma artzecha, istakkal deha meara itberiat, uleara tituv. vei mizze am atta, istakkal i it lach zechu daavahan, deyagin alach.

Kevan desallekin leh ledina, beve dina dilella, hahi seara, deihi gezerat dina, desair aleh devar nash, tavat min malka lemedan innun tefisin demalka, vechullehu atyayn chad chad kameh. beh shaata itkerivu be dina. it minnehon defatche bizchut, veit minnehon defatche bechova. ugezerat dina tavat dina.

Vei hahu bar nash la zache bedina, ma ketiv. vayachteru haanashim lehashiv el hayyabbasha velo yacholu. mishtaddelin innun deoru zechuteh leatava leh lehay alma, vela yacholu. may taama. ki hayyam holech vesoer alehem, gezera dedina, azil vesair bechovoy debar nash, veitgabbar alayyhu.

Keden nachtin aleh telat shelichan memanan, chad, dichtiv kol zachvavn, vechol chovin, deavad bar nash behay alma. vechad deavid chusheban yomoy. vechad dehava azil immeh, kad hava bime immeh. veha okimna digzerat dina la shachich, ad hahu zimna dichtiv, vayyisu et yona. vayyisu: kad natle leh mibbeteh, leve kivre.

Keden machriziyi aloy. i ihu zakkaa, machrize aleh veamre, havu yekar lediyyukena demalka, (Yeshayahu 57:2) yavo shalom yanuchu al mishkevotam holech nechocho. mena lan. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:8) vehalach lefanycha tzidkecha
896: Kevod Adonai yaasfecha. vei chayyayva ihi, machrize aleh veamru, vavy leh liflanya. tav leh dela yitbere. keden ma ketiv, vaytiluhu el hayyam vayyaamod hayyam mizzapo. kad alin leh leve kivre deihu atar dedina. keden gezerat dina dehava sair, shachich mizzapeh. venuna devala leh, da ihu kivra.

Ma ketiv, vayhi yona bime haddag. meoy dedag, da ihu beten sheol. menalan. dichtiv, (Yona 2:1) mibbeten sheol shivvati. veihu bime denuna hava, vekare leh beten sheol, shelosha yamim ushelosha lelot, illen telat yomin, devar nash bekivra, veitbekau meoy.

Levatar telata yomin, hahu tinnufa ithappach al anpoy, veomer lo tol ma diyhavat bi. achlat veshatit kol yoma, vela yahavt lemiskene, vechol yomach havo kechaggin uchemoadin, umiskene havo kafnin, dela achlu bahadach, tol ma diyyehavat bi. hada hu dichtiv, (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem vegomer, veha okimna.

Levatar da, mittelata yomin ulehala, keden itdan bar nash meenoy, miyyedoy, umeraggeloy, veukemuha ad telatin yomin. kol innun telatin yomin, itdanu nafsha vegufa kachada. uvegine kach ishtechach nishmeta letatta beara, dela salkat leatrah. keitteta deyatvat levar, kol yome mesaavuta. levatar, nishmeta salleka, vegufa itbele beara. ad hahu zimna deyittear kudesha berich hu lemetayyay.

Uzemina kala chada leatteara beve kivri, veyema, (Yeshayahu 26:19) hakitzu verannenu shochne afar ki tal orot tallecha vaaretz refaim tappil. ematay yehe da. bezimna deyitabbar malach hammavet mealma, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach vegomer. kevan devilla hammavet lanetzach, levatar, umacha Adonai elohim dima meal kol panim vecherpat ammo yasir meal kol haaretz. keden ketiv, vayyomer Adonai laddag vayyake et yona el hayyabbasha.

Kevan deittear hahu kala bene kivre, keden kol kivrayyay yakiu leinnun metayyay divhon levar. hada hu dichtiv vaaretz refaim tappil. may tappil. deyyaki lon levar. refaim, mahu refaim. dekabbilu. asvavta kemillekadmin, veatsiu garmin begarmin. veillen ikrun refaim.

Vei tema, ha ketiv (bishar ovde kochavim umazzalot) (Yeshayahu 26:14) refaim bal yakumu. ella vadday kol alma yittesun garmin beve kivre, aval minhon yekumun, uminhon la yekumun. veal da ketiv refaim bal yakumu. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dichtiv behu nevelati yekumun. uvehay nuna, ashkachna millin leasvavta, dechol alma.

Hay nuna kevan devala leyona mit. uveh hava yona telata yomin, levatar itkayyaym kemillekadmin, veake leyona levar, veha ukemuha, dichtiv vayyitpallel yona el Adonai elohav mimmee haddaga. ketiv hacha haddaga, uchetiv hatam (Shemot 7:21) vehaddaga asher bayor meta, veha ukemuha. kegavvna da, zeminat ara deyisrael leatara bekadmita, ulevatar vaaretz refaim tappil.

Veha okimna, deshiva dinin yachlefun aleh devar nash, kad nafik mehay alma. chad, hahu dina illaa, kad nafik rucha min gufa. 2, kad ovadoy umilloy azlin kammeh umachrize aloy. 3, kad ayiyil lekivra. 4, dina dekivra. Adonai, dina detolaatta. 6, dina degehinnam. 7, dina derucha deazla veshatat bealma, vela ashkachat atar nayycha, ad deyishtelim ovadoy. begin da, bae bar nash leistakkela tadir beovadoy, veyetuv kame mareh.

Vechad istakkol david malka bedinin illen devar nash, akdim veamar (Tehillim 104:1) barchi nafshi et Adonai, ad la tippuk min alma, beod deant ishtechachat im gufa. vechol keravay et shem kadsho, innun shayyfe gufa, demishtattefe kachada berucha. hashsheta detishtakkechun immah, akdimu levarcha shema kaddisha, ad la yimte zimna dela techllun levarcha, uleatava betiyyuveta, veal da amar barchi nafshi et Adonai haleluyah. atu innun chavrayyay venashku resheh.
897: (Shemot 35:5) kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. ta chaze kudesha berich hu kad bara alma, la bara leh, ella begin deyiyitun yisrael, vikabbelun orayyta. beorayyta itbere alma, veal orayyta kayyeyma. hada hu dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 33:25) im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti. orayyta ihi arka dechayye behay alma, vearka dechayye bealma deate.

Vechol man deishtadal beorayyta, keilu ishtaddal behechaleh dekudesha berich hu. dehechla illaa dekudesha berich hu, orayyta ihi. vechad bar nash asik beorayyta, kudesha berich hu kaim tamman, veatzit lekaleh, kema dichtiv, (Malachi 3) vayyakshev Adonai vayyishma vegomer. veishteziv bar nash mittelat dinin: middina dehay alma. umiddina demalach hammavt, dela yachil leshalletaa aleha. umiddina degehinnam.

Vayyikkatev sefer (70 amud alef) zikkaron. may ihu. ella it sefer leella, veit sefer letatta. zikkaron atar (nusach acher et) kayyayma kaddisha, denatil vechanish legabbeh, kol chayyin dilella. sefer zikkaron teren dargin deinnun chad, veraza da shem Adonai shem chad. Adonai chad. vecholla milla chada.

Begin deit shem, veit shem, shem (162 amud alef) leella, deihu itreshim (sefer acher ikre sham) mimma dela yedia, vela itremiz bidia kelal. veda ikre nekuda (93 amud alef) illaa. shem letatta, deikre shem, (Devarim 4:32) miktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim, begin diktze hashshamayim ikre zikkaron. vehay shem, ihu nekuda diltatta, deihu shem mehahu zikkaron, deihu ketze hashshamayim, denatil kol chayyin dilella. veda ihu ketze hashshamayim diltatta. veshem dileh ihi nekuda diltatta. nekuda da, ihu sefer dekayyeyma bechushebana, veda hu ulechoshve shemo. sefer dekaamaran, veshem, chad mila hu, bechol sitrin.

Nekuda da begin dekayyeyma beemtzaita, ihi illaa al kol deitachadan ba. shit sitrin, itachadan besefer (137 amud bet) illaa, veihu illaa alayyhu. shit sitrin itachadan besefer tattaa, veihu illaa alayyhu. veal da, sefer illaa, sefer tattaa, vecholla ikre tora.

Ma ben hay lehay. ella, sefer illaa ihu tora shebbichtav. begin deihi (214 amud alef, shemini 40 amud bet) setima, vela kayyeyma ella bichtav, detamman ihu atar leitgalaa letatta. uman ihu alma deate. sefer tattaa, da tora deikre tora shebbeal pe, uman ihu al pe, illen retichin diltatta, deihi kayyeyma alayyhu. uvegin delav innun bichlala dichtiva dilella, ikrun al pe.

Vetora da kayyeyma al pe, begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared vehaya learbaa rashim vetora illaa, af al gav deihi kayyeyma leella, la ikre al hakketav, ella shebbichtav, dekayyeyma bichtav, vehahu ketav itavid hechala legabbeh, veihi kayyeyma go hahu hechala, veittammerat tamman. uvegin kach ikre tora shebbichtav, vela al ketav.

Aval tora diltatta, ihi kayyeyma al retichaha, veikre al pe, dekayyeyma alayyhu. uvegin dela itchashivat (nusach acher ityehivat) millego, mikkelala dichtiva, la itavidu hechala lehay nekuda, kehahi nekuda illaa. uvegin dekayyeyma alayyhu ikre teruma.

Tu shemana mibbutzina kaddisha. teruma. mahu teruma. kema deokimna, tere mimmea. ta chaze, kol innun dargin kaddishin, di beraza dimhemnuta, dekudesha berich hu itgele behon, innun eser dargin, veinnun eser amiran, kema deukemuha. veillen eser sallekin lammea, vechad itzterich lan lehay nekuda tattaa learma lah, asir lan lenatla lah bilchodaha. ella lah ulevalah. veinnun tere meinnun mea dekaamaran, begin dela itzterich leafresha lon kelal, ella leyachada lah ulevalah. veal da itkere teruma bichlala chada.
Veta chaze, bechol yoma karoza kare, kol bene alma, bechu kayyayma milla da, veda hu (Shemot 35:5)
898: Kechu meittechem teruma laAdonai. vei tema dekashya milla alayychu. kol nediv libbo yevieha.

Mahu yevieha. ella mehacha olifna raza litzlota. devar nash dedachil lemareh umechavven libbeh ureuteh bitzlota, atkin tikkuna dilella, kema deukimna. bekadmita beshirin (197 amud alef) vetushebchan, dekaamrin malachin illain leella. uvehahu siddura detushebchan deka amre yisrael letatta, ihi keshitat garmaha, veitattakkanat betikkunaha. keitteta deitkashtat levalah.

Uvesiddura ditzlota, behahu tikkuna ditzlota dimyushav, atkinu ulemtaha vechol innun dilah. umitkashshetan kol innun bahadah, levatar deittakkan kolla veitsedaru, kad matu leemet veyatztziv, keden kolla mettakna, ihi veulemtaha, ad dematu legaal yisrael, keden itzterich lemekam kolla al kiumayyhu.

Begin dechad bar nash mate leemet veyatztziv, vecholla ittakkan. ulemtaha natle lah, veihi netilat garmah legabbe malka illaa. kevan dematu legaal yisrael, keden malka kaddisha illaa natil bedargoy, venafik lekabbela lah.

Vaanan, mikkamme malka illaa bainan lekayyeyma al kiumana, beemata birada. deha keden oshit yemineh legabbah, ulevatar semaleh, deshavve lah techot reshe, ulevatar itchabbeku tarvavyyhu kachada binshiku. veillen innun telat kadmayta, uvae bar nash leshavvava libbeh ureuteh, ulechavvna bechol hane tikkunin vesidurin ditzlota. pumeh velibbeh ureuteh kachada.

Hasheta demalka illaa umatronita innun bechibbura bechedva beinnun neshikin. man deitzterich lemishal sheeltin, yishal. deha keden shaata diruta ihu. kevan deshail bar nash sheeltoy mikkamme malka umatronita, keden yatkin garmeh biruteh velibbeh litlata acharanin, leatara chedva ditmiru, deha meillen telat itbarcha bidvekuta achara. veyatkin bar nash garmeh lemefak mikkammayyhu, uleannacha lon bechedva geniza deillen telat. veim kol da, dihe reuteh, deyitbarchun tattae, meinnun birkan dechedva temira.

Ucheden itzterich leminpal al anpoy, ulemimsar nafsheh, beshaata deihi nakta nafshin ruchin. keden ihi shaata lemimsar nafsheh bego innun nafshin deihi nakta, deha keden tzerora dechayye ihu kedka yeot.

Milla da shemana berazin devutzina kaddisha, vela ityeyhiv li reshu legallaa, bar lechu chaside elyonin. dei behahi shaata deihi nakta nafshin veruchin biru didvekuta chada, ihu yeshavve libbeh ureuteh leda, veyahiv nafsheh bidvekuta, behahu reuta, leachlela lah behahu devekuta. i itkabbilat behahi shaata behahu reuta, deinnun nafshin ruchin venishmatin deihi nakta. hay ihu bar nash deittzerir bitzrora dechayye behay alma, uvealma deate.

Vetu devaya leitkallela mikkol sitrin, malka umatronita, milella (189 amud alef) umittatta, uleitattera benishmatin bechol sitrin. itatterat benishmatin milella, veitatterat benishmatin mittatta. vei bar nash yechavven libbeh ureuteh lechol da, veyimsor nafsheh mittatta bidvekuta biruta kema deittemar. keden kudesha berich hu kare leh shalom letatta, kegavvna dehahu shalom dilella. hahu devarich lah lematronita veachlil lah veatar lah bechol itrin.

Uf hachi, hay bar nash kudesha berich hu kare leh shalom letatta, kema deat amer (Shoftim 6:24) vayyikra lo Adonai shalom. vechol yomoy hachi karan leh leella, shalom. begin deachlil veatar lematronita letatta, kegavvna dehahu shalom leella.

Vechad istallak hahu bar nash mehay alma, nishmateh salleka uvaka bechol innun rekiin, velet man deyimche bidah. vekudesha berich hu kare lah veamar (Yeshayahu 57:2) yavo shalom. ushechinta amra, yanuchu al mishkevotam vegomer. veyiftechun lah
899: Telesar ture deafarsemona dachya, vela yehe man deyimche bidah. veal da, zakkaa ihu man deyshavve libbeh ureuteh leda. veal da ketiv, kol nediv libbo yevieha et terumat Adonai legabbe malka illaa, kema deittemar.

Arim ribbi abba kaleh, veamar, vavy ribbi shimon, ant bachayyin, vaana bachena alach. la alach bachena, ella bachena al chavrayyay, uvachena al alma. ribbi shimon kevutzina dishragga, deadlik leella veadlik letatta. uvinhora deadlik letatta, nehirin kol bene alma, (nusach acher nahir leella) vavy lealma, kad yistalak nehora diltatta binhora dilella. man yanhir nehora deorayyta lealma. kam ribbi abba venashik leribbi chiyyay. amar leh millin illen havo techot yedach, veal da kudesha berich hu shadarni ad hacha, leitchabbera immechon zakkaa chulaki.

Ribbi yose patach kera avatrih veamar, (Shemot 35:10) vechol chacham lev bachem yavou veyyaasu vegomer, hay kera ukemuha. aval ta chaze, beshaata deamar kudesha berich hu lemoshe, (Devarim 1:13) havu lachem anashim chachamim unevonim, ashgach bechol yisrael, vela ashkach nevonim, hada hu dichtiv, vaekkach et rashe shivtechem anashim chachamim viduim, veillu nevonim la ketiv. vei tema denavon ihu darga illaa mechacham, hachi ihu vadday.

Ma ben hay lehay. chacham, ha ukemuha, deafillu talmid hammachkim lerabbeh ikre chacham. chacham, deyada legarmeh kol ma deitzterich. navon kama dargin it beh, deistakkal becholla, veyada bedileh uveacharanin. vesimanich, (Mishlei 12:10) yodea tzaddik nefesh behemto. (Shmuel 2 23:3) tzaddik moshel yirat elohim. vehacha chacham lev dayyka. ballev chacham, vela beatra achara, begin dekayyeyma ballev, venavon leella vetatta, istakkal bedileh uveacharanin.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta vegomer, hacha bitzlota devae bar nash letzallaa kammeh dekudesha berich hu, deihi pulechana chada rabba veyakkira, meinnun pulechanin demareh. ta chaze, it pulechana dekudesha berich hu, dekayyeyma beovada, deihu pulechana dekayyeyma beovada degufa, veihu pulechana. veit pulechana dekudesha berich hu, deihu pulechana penimaa yattir, deihu ikara decholla, kayyeyma behahu pulechana penimaa, deihu ikkara decholla.

Begufa it (Bereshit 16 amud alef) teresar shayyfin, dekayymin beovada degufa, kema deokimna. veinnun shayyfin degufa, ufulechana dekudesha berich hu, deovada kayyeyma behu. begin defulechana dekudesha berich hu, bitren sitrin, shayyfin degufa levar, veit teresar shayyfin acharanin, penimain lego min gufa. veinnun tikkunin penimain lego min gufa, leittakna behu tikkuna derucha, deihu pulechana yakkira penimaa dekudesha berich hu, kema deokimna go razin penimain dekaamar rabbi shimon, veinnun raza dechachmeta illaa, veityediu bene chavrayya, zakkaa chulakehon.
Tzelota devar nash, ihu pulechana derucha, veihu kayyeyma berazin illain, uvene nasha la yadin, deha tzelota devar nash bakat avirin, bakat rekiin, patchat pitchin, vesalleka leella.

Beshaata denahir nehora, veitperash nehora min chashocha, keden karoza azla bechullehu rekiin, ittakanu mare defitchin, marehon dehechalin, kol chad vechad al matreh. begin deinnun deshultanihon bimama, lav innun deshultanehon belelya. vechad al lelya, itavru shuletanin dimama, veitmenun shultanin acharanin, deshalitin belelya, veitchallefan illen beillen.

Veraza da, (Bereshit 1:16) et hammaor haggadol lememshelet hayyom vegomer. umemshelet hayyom umemshelet hallayla, shuletanin innun di memanan bimama, veshuletanin innun di memanan belelya. veillen ikrun memshelet hayyom. veillen ikrun memshelet hallayla.
Kad al lelya, karoza nafka, ittakanu shuletanin delelya, kol
900: Chad vechad leatreh. vechad nahir yemama, karoza nafka, ittakanu shuletanin dimama, kol chad vechad leatreh. (keden mateaberay shaltanin delelya vaatapekadevan shaltanin dimama) vechad karoza achriz, keden kullehu kol chad vechad, itpekkad al hahu atar deitchaze leh. keden shechinta kadma, venachta, veyisrael alin leve kenishta, leshabbecha lemarehon, patchin beshirin vetushebchan.

Devae leh lebar nash, (Vayikra 120 amud bet) kevan deatkin garmeh befulechana deovada, betikkune demitzva ukedusha, leyachada libbeh betikkuna defulechana penimaa demareh, uleshavvaa libbeh ureuteh behahu pulechana deinnun millin, (davar acher dekaamar) deha milla salleka.

Veinnun memanan dekayymin baavira, itmennun led sitre alma. listar mizrach itmanna memana chad, dekayyeyma baavira lehahu sitra, gezardiya shemeh, veimmeh sarchin memanan acharanin, deinnun mechakkan lehahi milla ditzlota, vesalleka baavira behahu sitra, venatil lah hay memana.

I hi milla kadka yeot, hu, vechol innun sarchin nashkin lehahi milla, vesallekin immah ad hahu avira dirkia leella, detamman memanan sarchin acharanin. beshaata denashsheke lehahi milla, patche veamre, zakkain attun yisrael, deyadittu leatera lemarechon beitrin kaddishin zakkaa ihu puma, demilla deatra da nafka minneh.

Keden parchin atvavn dekayymin baavira, devishma kaddisha ditresar atvavn, dehahu shema shallit baavira, vehay ihu (Bereshit 16 amud alef) shema, dehava tas beh eliyyahu, ad deistallak lishmayya. vehayeynu dekamar ovadya leeliyyahu, (Melachim 1 18) veruach Adonai yissaacha. begin devishma da, hava eliyyahu tas beh baavira, vehay ihu shema deshallit baavira.

Veinnun atvavn parchin vesallekin behahi milla, vehahu memana demaftechan deavvira bideh, vechol innun memanan acharanin, kullehu sallekin beh ad rekia, veitmesar bida dimmana achara, lesalleka leella.

Listar darom, it memana achara deshalta baavira lehahu setar, vechamma memanan acharanin vesarchin immeh. pesagniya shemeh, uveh mitachadan (nusach acher veleh atemaseraan) maftechan deavvira lehahu setar. vechol innun mare deaku, detzallan tzelota lemarehon miggo akta, miggo teviru delibba, i hahi milla kedka yeot, salka laavira behahu sitra, venatil lah hay memana, venashik lah (sefer acher begin desalleka behahu sitra) kad nashshik lah, patach veamar, kudesha berich hu yachos lekavlach (nusach acher 126) uveginach yitmele rachamin.

Sallekin immah kol innun memanan kaddishin, vechol innun sarchin dehahu sitra. ufarchin atvavn dishma kaddisha, deinnun 4 atvavn, demitatterin veshaltin behahu sitra daavira, vesallekin behahu sitra daavira, ad rekia, ad hahu memana dirkia deshallit behahu sitra.

Listar tzafon, it memana achara, veimmeh kama sarchin memanan deshaltin baavira, vehahu memana petachya shemeh, vehay itmanna baavira lehahu sitra, vechol innun dimtzallan tzelotin al baale devavu deakin lon, vechad milla dehahi tzelota salleka laavira behahu sitra, i zakkaa hu, natil lah hay memana, venashik lah.

Keden ittear rucha chada denafka miggo tehoma besitra detzafon, vehahu rucha kare bechol innun avirin, venatle kullehu hahi milla, vesallekin lah ad rekia venashshekin lah. patche veamre, marach yirme sanach lekamach.

Veazla vesalleka uvaka rekiin (sefer acher avirin) ad desallekin immah legabbe rekia kadmaa salleka tzelota, umatat legabbe chad memana, deitmana listar maarav, vetamman kayyaymin tisha pitchin, uvehu kayymin kama sarchin, vechamma memanan, vealayyhu memana chad di shemeh zevuliel.

Veda ihu devae leshammesha behay rekia bimama, vela ityehiv leh reshu, ad desalik nehora desihara, ucheden appik kol innun chelin, vechol innun memanan. vechad nahir yemama, alin kullehu befitcha chada, deinnun 9 pitchin, deihu pitcha illaa al kullehu. vechad tzelota salleka,
901: Alat behahu pitcha, vechullehu sarchin, vechullehu memanan, nafkin mehahu pitcha. vaalehon zevuliel, hahu rav memana, venafke kullehu venashsheke lah, umatan immah ad rekia tinyayna.

(Sefer acher birkia tinyayna salleka tzelota ad hahu rakia veitpetachu) vechad salleka tzelota ad hahu rekia, itpetachu teresar tarin dehahu rekia. uvehahu tara ditresar, kaim memana chad, dishmeh anael, vehay memana al kama chayyaylin, al kama mashshiryayn, vechad tzelota salleka, kaim hay memana vechariz al kol innun pitchin veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:2) pitchu shearim vegomer, vechullehu tarin petichin, vealat tzelota bechol innun pitchin.

Keden, atar chad memana sava deyomin, dekaim listar darom, dishmeh azriel sava, ulezimnin itkere machaniel, begin deitmana al shittin ribbo mashiryayn, vechullehu mare degadfin, mare demashiryayn, malyayn ayynin. ulegabbayyhu kayyeymin innun mashiryayn marehon deudenin. veikrun udenin, begin deinnun tzayytin, kol innun dimtzalan tzelothon bilchishu, biruta delibba, dela ishtema hahu tzelota leachara. hay tzelota salleka, vetzayytin lah kol innun deikrun mare deudenin.

Vei hahi tzelota ishtema leudenin devar nash, let man detzayit lah leella, vela tzayytin lah acharanin, bar man deshama bekadmita, begin kach bae leistammera dela yishmeun lehahi tzelota bene nasha. vetu, demilla ditzlota itachada bealma illaa, umilla dealma illaa, (Bereshit 3 amud bet) la itzterich lemishma.

Kegavvna da, man dekare besifra deorayyta, chad kare, vechad lishtok, vei tere karan beorayyta, gare mehemnuta dilella, begin dechad kala vedibbur kolla chad keden teren kalin uteren dibburin, ihu geriuta dimhemnuta. ella diyyehe kala vedibbur chad kema deitzterich, begin diyyehe hahu kala vehahu dibbur chad.

Vehahu memana, shemeh azriel sava. kad hahi tzelota salleka bilchishu, kol innun shittin ribbo mashiryayn, vechol innun mare deayynin, vechol innun mare deudenin, kullehu nafke venashsheke lehahi milla ditzlota desalleka. hada hu dichtiv, (tehillim la) ene Adonai el tzaddikim veaznav el shavatam. ene Adonai el tzaddikim, illen mare deayynin diltatta, begin deit (nusach acher delet) mare deayynin leella. veaznav el shavatam, illen marehon deudenin.

Rekia telitaa, hahi tzelota salleka umate lehahu rekia, vetamman hahu memana deikre gedarya, veimmeh kama sarchin vechamma memanan. veihu meshamesh 3 zimnin beyoma, lokovel chad sharvita dezihara denafik, salik venachit vela kayyeyma baatar chad, vehay ihu sharvita denatil 3 zimnin veitgeniz. vechad tzelota salleka, nachit hahu sharvita, vesagid kamme hahu tzelota, veikre hay rekia, rekia desharvita.

Vechad salleka hahi tzelota, hahu memana batar desagid, batash, behahu sharvita betinara, takkifa dezahir, deihu kaim beemtzaita dehahu rekia, venafku miggo hahu tinara, telat mea veshivin vechamesh chayyaylin deinnun genizin tamman min yoma deorayyta nachtat leara, begin deittakafu lechabbera (sefer acher laserabea) dela techot leara, veanzif behu kudesha berich hu, vealu go hahu tinara. vela nafkin bar hahu zimna ditzlota salleka, patche veamre (Tehillim 8:2) Adonai adonenu ma addir shimcha vegomer. da hi tzelota, desalleka al kol innun rekiin. keden sagdin legabbah.

Mikkan ulehala, tzelota mitattera beitrin illain, vesalleka lego rekia reviaa, ucheden shimsha nafik bedargoy, veshamshiel rav memana nafik, utelat mea veshittin vechamesh mashiryayn sallekin immeh, lego hahu rekia, veikrun yemot hachamma, vechullehu meatteran lehahi tzelota, beitrin devusemin deginta deeden.

Vetamman itakkavat tzelota, ad dechullehu mashiryayn sallekin immah lego hahu rekia chamishaa, vetamman ihu memana chad gadriel shemeh, vehu mare keravin dishar ammin. vechad tzelota salleka, keden izdaza hu, vechol mashiryayn dileh, veitbar
902: Chelayyhu, venafke vesagde, umeatterin lehahi tzelota.

Vesallekin immah ad dematu legabbe rekia shetitaa, ucheden nafkin kama chayyaylin, vechamma mashiryayn, umekabbelin lehahu tzelota, vesallekin bahadah, ad dematu leshivin tarin, detamman kaim chad memana, di shemeh anfiel, rav memana. veihu meatter lehahi tzelota, beshivin itrin.

Vechevan demitattera tzelota bechol hane itrin, keden mitchabberan kol innun chayyaylin dechullehu rekiin, vesallekin lehahi tzelota demitattera bechol itrin, legabbe rekia sheviaa. ucheden alat tzelota, vesandalfon rav yakkira illaa dechol maftechan demareh bideh, ail lehahu tzelota, lego shiva hechalin.

Ta chaze amar rabbi shimon shiva medorin inun vechulei, (amro hamegayhaym kevar nadepasev befarashat Bereshit daf 41 370) shiva hechalin illen, innun hechalin demalka, vehay tzelota kad mitattera bechol hani itrin, kad alat, mechabbar lon kachada, leitatra leella lemehve kolla chad kedka yeot. ushema dekudesha berich hu, mitattera bechol itrin, ella vetatta, lemehve chad, ucheden (Mishlei 10:6) berachot lerosh (Bereshit 26 amud alef) tzaddik ketiv.

Zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, deyada lesaddera tzeloteh kedka yeot. behay tzelota demitattera beh kudesha berich hu, ihu mechakke ad deyistayyeymun kol tzelothon deyisrael, ucheden kolla ihu bishlimu kedka yeot, ella vetatta. ad hacha millin ditzlota, leminda razin illain, mikkan ulehala it pikkude orayyta, deinnun kayyeymin bemilla, kema dekayymin beovada.
