Veinnun shit pikudin, vekayymin uf hacha bitzlota. chad, (Devarim 28:58) leyira et hashshem hannichbad vehannora. tinyayna, leahava oto. telitaa, levarcho. reviaa, leyachado. chamishaa, levarech kahana yat amma. shetitaa, limsor nishmateh leh. veillen shit pikudin dekayymin bitzlota demilla, bar innun pikudin (216 amud alef) dekayymin beovada, kegavvna detzitzit utefilin.

Leyira et hashshem, pikkuda da kayyeyma beillen tushebchan dekaamar david malka, uveinnun karbanin deorayyta, detamman bae bar nash ledachala mikkamme mareh, begin deinnun shirin kayyeymin behahu atar deikre yira. vechol innun haleluyah, deinnun raza deyira dekudesha berich hu. uvae bar nash leshavvaa reuteh beinnun shirin beyira, veukemuha chavrayyay kol innun razin deshirin vetushebchan, vechol innun razin dehalluyah.

Kevan demate bar nash leyishtabbach, yeshavve reuteh levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu, kegon yotzer or, yotzer hammeorot. leahava oto, kad mate leahavat olam, (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha, deda ihu raza dirchimu dekudesha berich hu, veha ukemuha. leyachada leh, shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad, dehacha kayyeyma raza deyichuda dekudesha berich hu, leyachada shemeh biruta delibba kadka chaze. umittamman ulehala adkaruta ditziat mitzrayim, deihu pikkuda leadkera yetziat mitzrayim dichtiv, (Devarim Adonai:15) vezacharta ki eved hayita beeretz mitzrayim.

Levarcha kahana yat amma, begin leachlela yisrael kachada, beshaata denatlin birchan leella, deha behahi shaata natla keneset yisrael birchan, veshaata diruta hu, limsor nafsheh legabbeh, ulemehav leh nishmeta biruta delibba, kad naflin al anpin, veamrin (Tehillim 25:1) elecha Adonai nafshi essa, dichavven libbeh ureuteh legabbeh, lemimsar leh nafsha biruta shelim. veillen innun shit pikudin dekayymin bitzlota, desallekin legabbe shit mea pikudin deorayyta.
Vei tema telesar acharanin yattir. innun kayyeymin leamshacha telesar mechilan derachame, decholla kelilan behu. (sefer acher behane) shit pikudin illen, ditzlota mitattera behu.
Zakkaa chulakeh, man dishavve libbeh ureuteh leda, uleashlema
903: Lon bechol yoma. uveillen talyayn acharanin saggiin. aval kad mate bar nash leatrin illen, itzterich leh lechavvevna libbeh ureuteh, leashlema hahu pikkuda dekayyeyma behahu milla. ucheden achrizu aleh veamre, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar. ata ribbi abba uneshakeh.

Patach ribbi yitzchak avatreh veamar, (Shemot 35:1) vayyakhel moshe et kol adat bene yisrael vegomer. amay kanish lon. begin lemimsar lon shabbat kemillekaddemin, deha bekadmita ad la avdu bene yisrael yat egla, masar lon et hashshabbat. veda ihu dela natru innun erev rav. kevan deshamu beni uven bene yisrael, amru vaanan milla da itmanna minan, miyyad (Shemot 32:1) vayyikkahel haam al aharon vegomer, veitmeshachu saggiin avatrayyhu. levatar demitu innun demitu, kanish moshe livni yisrael bilchodayyhu, veyahav lon shabbat kemillekadmin, hada hu dichtiv sheshet yamim tease melacha vegomer.
Lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem, hacha it raza derazin, leinnun deyade chachmeta illaa, raza deshabbat ha ukemuha chavrayyay. aval raza da, itmesar lechakkime elyonin, deha shabbat raza illaa hu.

Ta chaze (sefer acher beyoma shetitaa beshaata demate) beshaata deyoma shetitaa mata zimna deerev, keden, kochava chad missitra detzafon nahir, veimmeh shivin kochavin acharanin, vehahu kochava batash beinnun kochavin acharanin, veitkalylu kullehu behahu kochava, veitavid chad kelala deshivin. vehahu kochava itpashat, veitavid kemadura chada, lehita bechol sitrin. keden itpashat hahu madura sacharanayyhu deelef turin, vekayyeyma kechad chuta desachara.

Vehay madura deeshsha, mashich legabbeh gavvnin acharanin dilgo minneh. gon kadmaa yeroka. kevan dekayyeyma hay gavvna, salleka hahu madura deeshsha, vedalig leella al hahu gon yeroka, veal lego minneh, veshadde lehahu gon yeroka levar, vekayyeyma yeroka levar, vehahu madura deeshsha dechochava kelila lego.

Levatar, amshich avatreh gon achara tinyayna chivvavra, vehahu chivvavra al lego, kevan dekayyeyma hay gon, salleka hahu madura deeshsha dehahu kochava, veshadde lehahu chivvavra levar, veal ihu lego. vechen kol innun gavvnin, ad deshade lon levar, veayil ihu lego, vekariv legabbe hahi nekuda temira, lemetal nehora.

Patach veamar, (Yechezkel 1:4) vaere vehinni ruach seara baa min hatztzafon vegomer. yechezkel chama lehay chezu, betikkuna dela kayyeyma, bar beshaata deshallit hahu kochava kidkaamran, aval hay kera ukemuha. vehinne ruach seara, ukemuha, dehava ate lemichbash kol alma, lekammeh dinvuchadnetzar chayyayva. aval ruach seara da, ihu hahu kochava dekaamran, devala shivin kochavin acharanin, veda ihu ruach seara dechama eliyyahu, (Melachim 1 19:11) mefarek harim umeshabber selaim, veda dekayyeyma tadir kodam kolla, lemetar hahu dilgo, kiklifa lemocha.

Vaamay ikre seara. desair kolla, ella vetatta. baa min hatztzafon, deha min hahu sitra ka atya, vesimanich, (Yirmeyahu 1:14) mitztzafon tippatach haraa, deha kama sitrin acharanin itachadan behahu ruach seara, ubbegin kach nafka min hatztzafon.

Anan, begin deihi susefita dedahava. umissitra detzafon itachada da. vehay ihi nekuda (184 amud bet) emtzaita, dekayyeyma bechureba. uvegin deyada limfatte, shallit bego nekuda dishuva, vechol millin dishuva. bar ara deyisrael, kad sharan yisrael begavvah, ihu (davar acher lo) shalta alayyhu, ulevatar (141 amud alef) dechavu yisrael (davar acher lo) shalta al ara kaddisha, begin dichtiv, (Eicha 2:3) heshiv achor yemino mippene oyev.
Anan gadol da, ihu anana dechashocha, deachashich kol alma. ta chaze, ma ben anana laanana. hahu anana
904: Dichtiv (Bamidbar 10:34) vaanan Adonai alehem yomam. (Bamidbar 14:14) vaanancha omed alehem. (Vayikra 103 amud alef, 3 amud bet) hay ihu anana denahir vezahir, vechol nehorin itchazun go hahu anana. aval anana da, anana chashuch, dela nahir kelal, aval mana kol nehorin, dela yachlin leitchazaa kammeh.

Gadol, amay ikre gadol, veha zeer ihu. ella gadol ihu, kevan deshallit. davar acher gadol, hahu chashocha gadol, kevan dechasse kol nehorin vela itchazun kammeh, veihu gadol (nusach acher shallit) al kol ovadin dealma.

Veesh mitlakkachat, deha eshsha dedina kashya, la ade mineh lealmin. venoga lo saviv, af al gav dechol hay kayyeyma beh, noga lo saviv. mehacha olifna, deaf al gav delet sitra da, ella sitra (69 amud alef) dimsoovu, noga lo saviv, vela itzterich leh levar nash, ledachyay leh levar. may tama. begin denoga lo saviv, sitra dikdushsha dimhemnuta it leh, vela itzterich leanhaga beh kelana. veal da itzterich lemehav leh chulaka, besitra dikdushsha dimhemnuta.

Rav hamenuna sava, hachi amar, vechi noga lo saviv, veitzterich leanhaga beh kelana, hay noga lo, lego ihu, vela kayyeyma levar. uvegin dekayyeyma hahu noga lo miggo, ketiv umittochah keen hachashmal mittoch haesh. mittocha deman. mittocha dehahu noga. keen hachashmal: chash, mal, ha ukemuha, chevavn deeshsha (81 amud bet) memallela.

Aval mibbutzina kaddisha shemana ala raza derazin. kad arla share al kayyeyma kaddisha lesaava makdesha, keden hahu makdesha, itakkav millegallaa raza deat kayyayma, miggo arla. vechad hay noga al lego, veafrish ben arla, uven makdesha, keden ikre chashmal chash veitgalya. mal, mahu mal. kema deat amer (Yehoshua Adonai:4) mal yehoshua. raza deat kayyayma, itakkav milleitgallaa miggo arla.
Veit raza achara, deha nehora dileh, itchaze vela itchaze, vechad itgalya chashmal itabbar nehoreh. aval raza kadmaa, ihu beraza dikra kedka yeot, vecholla shappir ihu, veyaut hu.

Behay noga, mefatte leitteta, lenatla nehora. veal da ketiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) vechalak mishshemen chikkah, shavve hahu nehora lokovleh divrit. uvegine kach mefatte leh, venatla nehoreh. veda ihu pittuya dimfatte leitteta, dichtiv, (Mishlei Adonai:3) nofet tittofna sifte zara vegomer.

Ta chaze, beyoma shetitaa kad mata zimna deerev, dalig lego hahu (nusach acher madora) nehora deeshsha, vesalleka leella leaala go gavvnin. keden mettakkenin yisrael letatta, umesadderin seudatin, umatkenin patorin, kol chad vechad patoreh. keden chad shalhova nafik uvatash behahu madura, kevan devatash beh, mitgalgelan hahu shalhova, vehahu maddura vealin benukeba dithoma rabba, veittammeran veyatvat taman.

Vehahu shalhova ihu missitra dimina, uvegin dehu missitra dimina, abar lehahu maddura, veail leh lenukeba dithoma rabba, veyativ tamman ad denafik shabbeta. kevan denafak shabbeta, itzterich lehu leamma deyisrael levarcha al eshsha, venafka hahu shalhova, bevircheta diltatta, veshalit al hahu maddura kol hahu lelya, veitkafya hahu maddura.

Ta chaze, kevan deal shabbeta, veittammar hahu maddura, kol eshshin deeshsha kashya ittemaru veitkafyayn, vaafillu eshsha degehinnam, vechayyayvin degehinnam, it lon nayycha. vecholla tatta veella it lehu nayycha. kad nafak shabbeta, umevarchin yisrael al nura, keden nafkin kol eshshin demittammeran, kol chad vechad leatreh. uvegin dela leitteara eshsha achara, ketiv (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, eshsha demadbecha amay.
Ella kad al shabbeta, karoza kare bechullehu rekiin, ittekanu retichin, ittekanu mashiryayn, lekadmut marechon. keden nafik chad rucha missitra dedarom, vehahu rucha itperash
905: Al kol innun chelin umashiryayn delistar yemina, veitlabbeshan beh, vehahu rucha ikre levusha dikar deshabbeta. keden patore dehay alma, mittakkenan bechad hechala. zakkaa chulakeh dehahu bar nash, desiddura defatoreh itchaze tamman kedka yaut, vekayyeyma kolla mittakkena, bela kissufa, inish kefum cheleh.

Kad al shabbeta, itzterichu innun amma kaddisha leaschaa garmayyhu (136 amud bet) mishshimusha dechol, may taama. begin divchol, rucha achara azla veshatya veshara al amma. vechad bae bar nash lenafka min hahu rucha, uleaala berucha achara kaddisha illaa, bae leaschaa garmeh, lemishre aleh hahu rucha illaa kaddisha.

Ta chaze raza illaa demilla, kol innun shit yomin, (keyama milla decholla) itachadan beraza dechad nekuda kaddisha, vechullehu yomin itachadan beh. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin levar besitra achara. veit yomin acharanin, dekayymin lego (hakedama Adonai amud bet) meiggula kaddisha, veitachadan binkuda kaddisha.

Veyisrael kaddishin, vechol innun demitassekin bikdushsha, kol yoma deshabbeta, itachadan kol innun shit yomin, beinnun shit yomin dilgo deitachadan behahi nekuda, itachadan behay, begin lenatra lon. vechol innun shit yomin (davar acher veinnun shit yomin dilgo) deshabbeta, hahi nekuda temira ihi. kevan deal shabbeta, keden salleka hahi nekuda, veitattera veitachada leella, vechullehu temirin begavvah.

Ta chaze, it yamim veit yamim. yeme chol, kema deittemar, veillen kayyeymin levar leammin. yeme hashshabbat, deinnun yeme hashavua, kayyeymin leyisrael. vechad salleka hay nekuda, kolla itgeniz, veihi salleka, kevan deihi salleka, ikre shabbat.

Mahu shabbat. i tema begin shevita, dichtiv ki vo shavat, yaut hu. aval raza demilla, kevan desalleka hay nekuda, unehora nahir, keden mitattera ihi baavahan, kevan demitattera ihi baavahan, keden itchabberat veitachadat behu, lemehve chad, veikre kolla shabbat. shabbat: 300 bat. 300 ha ukemuha, raza ditlat avahan, demitachadan bevat yechida, veihi mitattera behu, veinnun bealma deate. vecholla ihu chad. veda ihu 300 bat, lemeheve kolla chad.

Vei tema, shabbat haggadol, veihu leella, amay ikre shabbat. ella vadday hachi hu. veraza demilla, bechol atar nekuda deihi ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 17:8) shamreni keishon bat ayin, begin deihi (nekuda) ikkara dechol ena, ikre bat.

Alma deate, ihu (180 amud alef) hechala lehahi nekuda illaa, vechad ihi kayyeyma, venatla begadpaha laavahan, leitattera leella ikre kolla shabbat. vechad avahan mitatteran leella, bego nekuda illaa, ikre shabbat. nekuda tattaa (70 amud bet) kad mitattera baavahan ikre shabbat.

Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere 0) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear
906: Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.
Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun
907: Chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.

Kevan dehay rucha shara al alma, kol ruchin bishin, vechol mekatregin bishin, istalaku mealma vela baenan letzallaa al netura, begin deyisrael innun netirin behahu rucha, vesukkat shalom perisat gadfaha alayyhu, veinnun netirin mikkolla.

Vei tema, ha tanenan, dela yippuk bar nash yechiday, la belelya reviaa deshabbeta, vela belelya deshabbeta, uvae bar nash leistammera. veha amaran, divlelya deshabbeta netirin bene nasha mikkol mekatregin dealma, vela bainan letzallaa al netura.

Ta chaze, hachi hu vadday, lelya reviaa deshabbeta, baenan leistammera minnayyhu, may tama. begin dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:14) yehi meorot, meerat ketiv chaser, veha ukemuha, divgin dehi chasera, kama chavile tehirin itkelilan behay meorot. levavtin umeorot innun bigriuta desihara, vechullehu shallitin behahu lelya.

Belelya deshabbeta, kevan dechullehu mitbadran leaala benukeba deafra, dela yachlin leshalletaa, bae bar nash yechiday, leistammera. vetu, af al gav dela yachlin leshalletaa, itchazyayn lezimnin, uvar nash yechiday bae leistammera.

Milla da hachi tanenan, vei hachi geriuta dintura ihu. aval beshabbeta netiru ishtechach leamma kaddisha, vekudesha berich hu kad al shabbeta, meatter lechol chad vechad miyisrael, uvae deyinterun leh lehay itra kaddisha, deitattaru beh, veaf al gav deinnun la ishtechachu beyishshuva, lezimnin levar nash yechiday itchazun, veittera mazzaleh. veitzterich leh levar nash, leitattera beitra kaddisha, ulenatra leh.

Sof sof, netiru ishtechach behahu lelya leamma kaddisha, hoil vesukkat shalom perisa al amma, deha tanenan, bechol atar desukkat shalom ishtechach, sitra achara la ishtechach tamman. veal da netura ihu unetura shechiach.

Yoma deshabbeta, chedva ihu lecholla, vecholla itnetar leella vetatta. unehora (nusach acher unekuda) tattaa nahara lesalleka leella, bishfiru deitrin shivin chulakin yattir, vesava dechol savin ittear.

Keden kad salik nehora, amma kaddisha mekaddeme leve kenishta bilvush yekar bechedva, mitatteran beitra kaddisha dilella, behahu rucha dekayyeyma alayyhu letatta, meshabbechan beshirin vetushebchan, vesallekin tushebchan leella, veillain vetattain kullehu bechedva, umitatteran kullehu kachada. patche illae veamre, zakkain attun amma kaddisha beara, demarechon itattar alayychu, vechol chelin kaddishin, mitatterin beginechon.
Hay yoma, yoma denishmatin ihu, velav yoma degufa, begin deshultanu ditzrora denishmatin ihu, vekayyman illain vetattain kullehu beziuuga
908: Chada, beitra derucha yetera illaa kaddisha.

Tzelota deshabbeta, deamma kaddisha, telat tzelotin ishtechachu behay yoma, lokovel telat shabbate, veukemuha, vechullehu chad. kevan dealu amma kaddisha leve kenishta, asir leishtaddela afillu betzorech be kenishta, ella bemille tushebchan utzelota, veorayyta, vechadka chaze lon.

Uman (206 amud alef, emor 105 amud alef) deishtaddal bemillin acharanin, uvemillin dealma, da ihu bar nash deka mechallel shabbeta, let leh chulaka beamma deyisrael. teren malachin memanan al da, beyoma deshabbeta, veinnun shavu yedehon al resheh, veamre, vavy liflanyya, delet leh chulaka bekudesha berich hu. veal da, bae leishtaddela bitzlota uveshirin uvetushebchan demarehon, uleishtaddela beorayyta.

Hay yoma, ihu yoma denishmatin, deitattera hahu tzerora denishmatin. (betushebchan demarehon) begin kach meshabbeche betushebchan tushbachta denishmeta, vehayeynu (138 amud alef) nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar vechulei. velet tushebachta ella besitra denishmeta verucha, vehay yoma, kayyeyma berucha venishmeta, velav degufa.

Tushebachta dedarga achara illaa, raza deyoma, shimsha kaddisha deihu nehora dimama, hayeynu yotzer or. raza dinhora denahir, deminneh itzenan venaharin kol innun chayyaylin, retichin, vechochavayya umazzale, vechol innun deshaltin al alma.
Tushebachta dealma deate beyoma da, hayeynu el adon. vetushebachta da, ihu beraza deesrin uteren atvavn illain kaddishin, demitatteran baavahan uvirticha illaa kaddisha.

Atvavn (hakedama 3 amud bet) zeirin, innun esrin uteren atvavn, deinnun bealma tattaa, deinnun el baruch gedol dea vechulei, vela it ben teva latteva, revavcha achara, ella at reshima bechol teva veteva. (132 amud bet) uvealma illaa, it revavcha, vesitrin kaddishin, ben at leat. veda ihu, tushebachta al tushebachta, deatvavn illain deyoma sheviaa, (204 amud alef) ka meshabbach veamar lemalka illaa yotzer bereshit.

Kad tushebachta da salleka leella, shitin retichin illain dekaamaran, mizdammenin venatle lehay tushebachta meamma kaddisha, vesalke lah leitattera ba, bechamma retichin illain, di memanan, vechol innun tzaddikayyay divginta deeden, kullehu mitatterin betushebachta da, vechol innun retichin, vechol innun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, kullehu sallekin betushebachta da, ad raza dechuresyyay.

Kad mata lechuresyay kaddisha, tushebachta da dechol yisrael, kayyeyma tamman, ad zimna dekamre kedushsha illaa demusaf. ucheden silluka diltatta leella, leitachada kolla leella leella, lemeheve kolla chad. da ihi tushebachta, desalleka al kullehu tushebchan.

Mikkan ulehala, siddura ditzlota dishar yome, ad yismach moshe vechulei, chedvavta dedarga illaa, ikkara daavahan, dechadde behahu adva dileh, kad salik kuresyyay legabbeh, venatil lah, umitchabberan kachada. veda ihu chedva deorayyta illaa dilella, tora shebbichtav. dechadde beorayyta diltatta, tora shebbeal pe, veitchabbaru da beda.
Kevan deitchabbaru kachada, bae bar nash leachlela behahu chedva leamma kaddisha, yismechu vemalchutach shomre shabbat vechulei, elohenu velohe avotenu retze na vimnuchatenu.

Raza desefer tora beyoma da, ha ukemuha tanenan ketiv, (Nechemya 8:8) veyikreu besefer betorat haelohim meforash vesom sechel vayyavinu vammikra veha ukemuha raza, deinnun pissuke taame, umassoret, vechol innun diukin, (nusach acher tikkunin) verazin illain, kolla itmesar lemoshe missinay. i vechol hane diukin itmesar orayyta lemoshe, sefer tora deihu vechol innun kedushan, amay ihu chaser mikkol hane tikkunin verazin deitmesaru leh lemoshe beorayyta.
Ella raza da, kad kuresyyay kaddisha mitattera, veitkelilat battora shebbichtav, kol innun diukenin, vechol innun taamin umassorot, kullehu alin bignizu, veitreshimu
909: Bego kuresyyay kaddisha, veinnun diukenin, deail orayyta devichtav, beorayyta dival pe, uvehu itabberat, keitteta deitabberat min dechura, veishtaaru atvavn illain lechodayyhu bikdushayyhu kadka chaze. uleitchazaa beve kenishta, deha itbarchat veitatterat kuresyyay meraza detora shebbichtav, vetamman ail kol innun diukenin, veihi itkadshat minneh, bae leitchazaa beatvavn lechodayyhu kadka yeot.

Ucheden, kolla itkaddash bikdushsha illaa kadka chaze, kol shekken vekol shekken behay yoma. behay yoma bae lesalleka shiva guverin, lokovel shiva kalin, deinnun raza deorayyta. uvizmanin uvemoadin chamesh, go raza da. beyoma dechippure shit. go raza illaa da.

Vecholla raza chada. chamesh, deinnun chamesh dargin letatta, middarga deor kadmaa letatta, veinnun raza deorayyta. shit, deinnun shit sitrin vecholla raza chada. sheva innun sheva kalin. vechullehu raza chada, illen veillen.

Berosh chodesh ittosaf chad al telata, begin shimsha, denahir behahu zimna, lesihara, veittosaf nehora al sihara, vehayeynu raza (Bereshit 17 amud alef) demusaf. besefer tora, bae lishtema chad kala vedibbur.

Siddura lesaddera amma kaddisha beyoma da, uvishar yomin desefer tora bae lesaddera uletakkena tikkuna, bechad kurseyyay deikre teva, vehahu kurseyyay deliheve beshit (14 amud bet, 43 amud alef, shalach 164 amud bet) dargin, lesalleka behu vela yattir, dichtiv, (divrei hayamim 2 9:18) veshesh maalot lakkisse. vedarga chad leella, leshavvaa aleh sefer tora, uleachazaa leh lecholla.

Kad salik sefer tora letamman, keden baan kol amma lesaddera garmayyhu letatta, beemata bidchilu beretet bezia, ulechavvna libbayyhu, kemma dehashta kayyaymin al tura desinay lekabbela orayyta, veyehon tzayytin veyirchun udenayyhu. velet reshu leamma lemiftach pumehon, afillu bemille deorayyta, vechol shekken bemilla achara, ella kullehu beemata, keman delet leh puma veha ukemuha, dichtiv, (Nechemya 8:Adonai) uchefitcho amdu chol haam. (Nechemya 8:3) veazne chol haam el sefer hattora.
Amar rabbi shimon, kad mafkin sefer tora betzibbura, lemikre beh, mitpattechan tare shemayay derachamin, umeorrin et haahava leella, veive leh levar nash lememar hachi.

Bericha shemeh demare alma, berich kitrach veatrach, yehe reutach im ammach yisrael lealam, ufurekan yeminach, achze leammecha bevet mikdashcha, uleamtoye lana mittov nehorach, ulekabbela tzelotana berachamin. yehe raava kodamach, detorich lan chayyim betivu, veleheve ana pekida bego tzaddikayya, lemircham alay, ulemintar yati, veyat kol dili, vedi leammacha yisrael. at hu zan lecholla, umefarnes lecholla, at hu shallit al kolla, at hu deshallit al malchayya, umalchuta dilach hu. ana avda dekudesha berich hu, desagidna kammeh, umikkamme dikar orayyteh, vechol iddan veiddan. la al eynash rachitzna, vela al bar elahin samichna, ella beelaha dishmayya, dehu elaha keshot, veorayyteh keshot, uneviohi keshot, umasge lemebad tavvavn ukeshot. beh ana rachitz, velishmeh kaddisha yakkira ana emar tushebchan. yehe raava kodamach, detiftach libbay beorayytach vetehav li benin dichrin deavdin reutach. vetashlim mishalin delibbay, velibba dechol ammach yisrael letav ulechayyin velishlam amen.

Veasir lemikre besifra deorayyta, bar chad bilchodoy, vecholla tzayytin veshatkin, begin deyishmeun millin mippumeh, keillu kabbilu lah hahi shaata mittura desinay. uman dekare beorayyta, lehve chad kaim aleh, veshatik. dela yishtama bar dibbur chad bilchodoy, la teren dibburin, leshon kodesh chad, vechad hu, vela teren dibburin, vei teren mishtakkechin besefer tora, geriuta deraza dimhemnuta ihu ugeriuta diykara deorayyta ishtechach besefer tora, uvae chad kala. metargem chad. veraza da kelifa umocha. (raza dealma da veraza dealma deate).
Kolla shatkin, vechad kare, dichtiv, (Shemot 20:1) vaydabber elohim et kol haddevarim haelle lemor ihu leella, vechol amma letatta,
910: Dichtiv, (Shemot 19:17) vayityatztzevu betachtit hahar. uchetiv (Shemot 19:3) umoshe ala el haelohim.

Vehahu dekare beorayyta, yeshavve libbeh ureuteh leinnun millin, vechi ihu shelicha demareh, besidura dehani millin, lemishma lechol amma, deha ihu kaim kedugema illaa. begin kach, man desalik lemikre beorayyta, yesader innun millin bekadmita beveteh, vei lav, la yikre beorayyta, menalan mehahu dibbur, ad la yashma orayyta leamma kaddisha ma ketiv, (Iyov 28:27-28) az raa vaysapperah hchinah vegam chakarah, ulevatar, vayyomer laadam hen yirat Adonai hi chachma vegomer.

Asir leh leman dekare beorayyta lemifsak parsheta, o afillu milla chada, ella baatar defasak moshe parsheta leamma kaddisha, yafsik. vela yafsik millin defarsheta deshabbeta da, befarsheta deshabbeta achara.

Raza da, beshaata deifsiku parshiyayn, kol chad vechad itattera vekayyeyma kamme kudesha berich hu. kevan deashlimu lemifsak hani parshiyayn dechol shatta, itattaru kammeh kudesha berich hu, veamre ana mishshabbat peloni, (sefer acher matzebaveraa peloni) vaana mishshabbat peloni. (matzebaveraa peloni)

Behahi shaata, kera leyufiel rav memana, ulechamshin utelat retichin kaddishin ditchot yedeh, deitmanun beshimusha deorayyta, vechol reticha ureticha mani leh, lehay reticha al parsheta pelanya, divshabbat peloni. ureticha peloni, al parsheta pelanya, deshabbat peloni. vechol chad vechad, meshammesha leorayyta, dehahu shabbat dileh. veasir lan learva illen beillen, vela leaala reticha birticha dechavreh, afillu kimlo nima. vaafillu bechad teva, o afillu beat chad, ella kol chad vechad, kemma defasik lon kudesha berich hu, uchemma demane lon beinnun parsheyayn, kol chad vechad al matreh.

Veal da, kad mitattera parsheta da, salkan innun millin dehahi parsheta, deishtelim betzibbura, venatil lon hahu reticha, dimmana behahi parsheta, vesalik lon kame kudesha berich hu, veillen millin mammash, kayymin kammeh veamrin, ana parsheta pelanya, deashlimu li tzibbura peloni, hachi vehachi.

I ishtelim kadka chaze leh, sallekin innun millin, umitatteran al kuresyay kaddisha, vehahu reticha meshammesha kammeh, kol reticha ureticha, parsheta dechol shabbeta veshabbeta, vechullehu mitatteran bego kuresyyay kaddisha, uvehu ihi salleka leityachada leella leella, veitavid kolla kelala chada. begin kach, zakkaa chulakeh man deashlim parsheta dechol shabbeta veshabbeta, kadka yaut, kema deafsiku leella.

Tere zimne, karenan besefer tora beshabbeta, bammincha, beshaata dedina talya, leidan erev. tzerichin leachlela semala bimina, deha orayyta mitterin (84 amud alef) sitrin ityeyhivat, dichtiv, (Devarim 33) mimino esh dat lamo, yemina usemala. begin kach sefer tora bammincha day baasara pesukin, o yattir, aval la shelimu defarsheta, deha shelimu defarsheta la heve, ella bimina, vimina talyay ad shaata demincha, veha ukemuha.

Bashsheni beshabbeta, uvachamishi beshabbeta, begin deka nachtin dargin letatta, deinnun kelala deorayyta. vei tema, ha neviin mitparshan letatta. ella hachi hu vadday, aval hane diltatta, kullehu kelala deorayyta, vechol chad vechad kalil lechol chad vechad.

Veraza demilla, illen dargin illain, innun ikrun parsheta chada, ulevatar nafkin minnayyhu tesha dargin, deitachadan kachada, uvegin kach tisha guverin, telat beshabbeta bammincha, utelat beyoma tinyayna, utelat beyoma chamishaa, ha tisha.

Uvesifra derav yeva sava, bammincha beshabbeta, ha itar raza dismala, (24 amud alef) unekuda tattaa, behahu sitra dismala, mekabbela raza deorayyta, keden behahi shaata, natla missitra dismala, umiddileh karenan.
911: Detesha, (nusach acher sefiran) vekarenan tesha, veinnun shit dechol, utelat beshaata deittear semala beshabbeta, uleitkalla kolla kachada. veihi mitattera behu, bitlat sitrin, kegavvna ditlat sitrin illain, deinnun kelala defarsheta deshabbeta. zakkaa chulakeh man dezache likara deshabbeta, zakkaa ihu bitren almin, bealma den, uvealma deate.

Ketiv (Shemot 16:29) al yetze ish mimmekomo bayom hashshevii mahu mimmekomo. tanenan, mimmekomo mehahu atar deitchaze limehach. veraza demilla, dichtiv, (Yechezkel 3:12) baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. veda ihu makom, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 3:Adonai) ki hammakom asher atta omed alav. atar yedia ihu leella, vekarenan leh makom, deishtemoda beh yekara illaa dilella. ubbegin kach, azharuta lebar nash deha mitattera beitra kaddisha dilella, dela yippok minneh dei (yippuk mippumeh maylavelaa dechol) yippok mineh, ka mechallel shabbeta. bidoy, baavidta. kema deokimna. beragloy, lemehach levar mittere alfin ammin, kol illen chillula deshabbeta ihu.

Al yetze ish mimmekomo, da ihu atar yekara dikdushsha da, deha minneh levar, atar deelohim acherim ihu. baruch kevod Adonai mimmekomo. kevod Adonai (Bereshit 25 amud alef) dilella. mimmekomo, da kevod diltatta veda ihu raza daattara deshabbeta, begin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo, berich hu lealam ulealme almin.

Ketiv (Shemot 33:21) hinne makom itti, makom itti, vadday da ihu makom tamir veganiz, dela ityeyda kelal. mashma dichtiv itti, atar dela itgalya, vekayyeyma temira, veda ihu atar illaa leella leella, hechala illaa tamir veganiz. aval da, ihu atar letatta kidkaamran. veda ihu makom deitperash leella, veitperash letatta, ubbegin kach al yetze ish mimmekomo bayom hashshevii.

(Bamidbar 35:5) umadotem michutz lair et peat kedma alpayim baamma vegomer, (209) ha ukemuha beinnun razin illain. aval alpayim baamma, deyarta teren (hakedama Adonai amud alef) sitrin lechol setar, veihi mitattera tadir bitren sitrin, ben leella ben letatta. vesimanich shechina la sharya levar mittechuma deitchaze lah.

Kad nafak shabbeta, tzerichin yisrael diltatta, leakava, deha yoma rabba illaa ihu. (itzterich leitakkava aleh) uvehay yoma, ushepiza rabba veyakkira, ka sharya aleh, begin kach bae leitakkeva, leitchazaa dela dachakin beushepiza kaddisha. keden patche yisrael veamre, (Tehillim 78:38) vehu rachum yechapper avon vegomer, detikkuna shappira ihu behay lelya, kevan dedina ithaddar leatreh, ma dela itchaze kad ayiyil shabbeta, dedina istallak, vela ishtechach.

Beshaata defatche yisrael vayhi noam, ukedushata desidra, kol innun chayyayvin degehinnam, patchin veamri, zakkain attun yisrael amma kaddisha, zakkain attun tzaddikayyay, denatre pikkude orayyta. vavy lon lechayyayvayya, dela zachu lemetar orayyta, keden 55 kadim, vecharoza ittear veamar, (Tehillim 9:18) yashuvu reshaim lishola kol goyim shecheche elohim. vechol illen chavile tehirin, tardin lon begehinnam, velet man dimrachem alehon. zakkain innun kol natre shabbeta behay alma, veka meannege lehahu ong desharya milleella, kidkaamran.

Hay man deshare betaanita beshabbeta, tere mitare aleh kamme malka kaddisha. chad, hahu rucha illaa kaddisha deitzterich leitannega, vela itannag. vechad, hahu memana dekayyeyma al man deshare betaanita, vesangaryah shemeh. vesallekin kame malka kaddisha, umitare aleh.

Vehahu rucha istallak geria mehahu ithanuta diltatta. vechad hay rucha la ishtelim letatta, rucha achara dilella la ishtelim. kevan dela ishtelim letatta uleella, keden itchaze hahu bar nash leitlatteya, uleitannesha. ella kevan deishtelim zimna achara, vehahu memana deitmana al innuyyay
912: Vetaanita, ishtelim go innun memanan acharanin, beinnuga dilella, korin leh kol gezar dina, deitgezar meinnun shivin shenin illain.
Lemalka dechadde behillula dileh, vechol bene nasha chaddan immeh, chama chad bar nash yahiv bekolar, pakid aloy, vesharyyuhu. begin deyishtakkechun kolla bechedva.

Ulevatar, mithadderin illen memanan deanshin livne nasha, veitparin minneh debar nash, al deishtechach begineh geriuta ella vetatta. may takkanteh. letiv taanita al taanita. may taama. da battil innuga deshabbeta, yevattel innuga dechol.

Vei ihu mevattel innuga deshabbeta, veka mitanneg bachol, dame keman dechashav lemilla achara, yattir mimma dechashiv leh lekudesha berich hu. rucha illaa, kaddisha dekudeshin desharya aleh, la anig, uvattil leh minneh. rucha achara dechol, desharya levatar al alma, chashiv veka meanga leh. keden mehadderin umitparin minneh, behay alma, uvealma deate.

Begin kach, itzterich taanita acharina, beyoma kadmaa dechol, bezimna desharya al alma hahu rucha dechol. uvehay it leh asvavta, kevan dela chashiv lerucha dechol. vesimanich (Vayikra Adonai:23) veheshiv et haggezela asher gazal vegomer. gazlan, la chashiv lekudesha berich hu, la chashiv livni nasha, begin kach let leh onsha kaggannav. gannav, dechashiv livni nasha, yattir mekudesha berich hu, it leh onsha behay alma, uvealma deate. zakkaa ihu, man deishtelim letatta, lehahu oneg illaa kadka chaze.
Yoma da, mitattera beshivin itrin, ushema illaa (88 amud bet) kaddisha, ishtelim vechol sitrin, veitnehiru kullehu dargin, vecholla bechedva devirkan, uvikdushsha al kedusha, vetosefet dikdushsha.

Kidusha demaale shabbeta, da ihi kedushsha deshabbat bereshit. deha itkaddash mittelatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin detappuchin (vaychi 249 amud bet) kaddishin. uvaenan leadkera al hay kidusha, kelala deovada divreshit, venayycha beraza ditlatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin deitkelilan behu, raza desahaduta deovada divreshit, dehayynu (Bereshit 2:1-2) vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam vegomer. vaychal elohim, deit besahaduta da, telatin (hakedama Adonai amud bet) vachamesh tevin. telatin uteren shevilin, utelat dargin detappuchin kaddishin.

Telat dargin, deinnun: shevii. shevii. shevii. veit beh raza dealma illaa, veraza dealma tattaa, veraza dechol mehemnuta. telat zimnin elohim, chad, alma tattaa. vechad, pachad yitzchak. vechad, alma illaa kaddisha, kodesh kudeshin. bae bar nash lemishad sahaduta da, bechedva, biruta delibba, leashada kamme mareh dimhemnuta. vechol man deyashid da, veyishave libbeh ureuteh leda, mechapper al kol chovoy.

Barucha atta Adonai elokenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav veratza vanu vechulei, hay kiddusha ihu bechad matkela, lokovel sahaduta dimhemnuta, veinnun telatin vachamesh tevin acharanin, kama deit bevaychullu. kolla sallekin leshivin tevin, (132 amud bet) leitattera behu shabbat, demaale shabbeta. zakkaa chulakeh devar nash, diyyechavvevn reuteh lemillin illen, likara demareh.

Kiddusha deyoma, ha ukemuha bore peri haggefen, vela yattir. deha yoma kaim lekaddesha leh, ma delet hachi belelya, deanan tzerichin lekaddesha leh, behani millin, kema deokimna. vela itkaddash hay lelya, ella beamma kaddisha letatta, kad sharya alayyhu hahu rucha illaa. vaanan baenan lekaddesha leh biruta delibba, lechavvevna data lehay.
Veyoma ihu ka mekaddesha leh. veyisrael mekaddeshe bitzlotin uvautin, umitkadshin bikdushateh, behay yoma. zakkain yisrael, amma kaddisha, deachasinu yoma da, achasanat yeruta lealmin.

Levatar denafik shabbeta, bae bar nash leafrasha, ben kodesh lechol. amay. deha ityehiv reshu limmanan diltatta leshalletaa al alma, uvechol ovadin dealma, leachazaa yichuda, beatar kaddisha, bikdushsha illaa, uleafresha letatta miyichuda illaa,
913: Begin dechol eshshin acharanin, ittemaru veitgenizu beyoma deshabbeta, bar eshsha chad dikdushsha illaa, deitgalya veitkelila bikdusha deshabbeta. vechad hay eshsha itgalyay, kol eshshin acharanin ittemaru, veitgenizu kammeh. vehay eshsha, ihi daakeda deyitzchak, deitlahata al gabbe madbecha. begin kach, bae levarcha al nehora deeshsha. vehay eshsha, la bae eshsha dechol, ella eshsha deshabbat, vehay eshsha, ihu eshsha denafik mehahu essa dilella.

Veda ihu eshsha desavil eshsha. vechevan dehay eshsha denafik meeshsha dilella itbarcha bivracha dinhora, keden kol shear eshshin acharanin nafkin, veitmannan beduchetayyhu, veityeyhiv lon reshuta leanhara.

Behahi shaata deka mevarchin al eshsha, izdammenan arba retichin, arba mashiryayn letatta, leanhara mehahu eshsha mevarcha, veinnun ikrun meore haesh. begin kach, baenan leachpeya 4 etzbean dida dimina, uleanhara lon miggo hahu nehora dishraga demitbarcha.

Veinnun etzbean, remez leinnun meore haesh, dinhire veshalte mehahu nehora dishraga demitbarcha. uvegin deinnun dargin letatta, kad achze bar nash etzbean kamme hahu nehora dishraga, bae leachpeyay lon kammeh, begin dehahu nehora shalta alayyhu, veinnun naharin minneh.

Bishar birchan baenan lezakfa lon leetzbean, begin leachazaa kedushsha illaa, dedargin illain, deshaltin al kolla, dishma kaddisha itattar behu veitkaddash behu, veitbarchan kullehu dargin kachada, venaharin miggo butzina illaa decholla, ubbegin kach baenan lezakfa lon leella. vehacha baenan leachpeyay etzbean kame sharga, begin leachazaa dargin diltatta, denaharin miggo butzina dilella, umehacha shaltin venaharin minnah, veinnun meore haesh.

Vechol yoma anan mevarchenan meore or, deinnun nehorin illain, dekayyman behahu or kadmaa, veitbarchan kullehu dargin, venaharin kullehu kachada, miggo butzina illaa. vehani ikrun meore haesh. uvegine raza da, mevarchin bore meore haesh.

Vei tema, amay bore, vela amru meir meore haesh. hoil veka naharin mehahu esh, mehahu butzina mevarcha. ella kevan deal shabbeta, kol innun dargin diltatta, vechol innun denaharin veshaltin, kullehu alin veitkelilu behay sharga, veittamaru veitgenizu, veitnnetaru beh, vela yitchazun beh, ella hahu nekuda bilchodaha, vechullehu ittemaru begavvav, kol yoma deshabbeta.

Kevan denafak shabbeta, appik lon lechol chad vechad, keillu hahi shaata itberiu, venafku kullehu veitberiu kemilkaddemin, veitmeniu al duchetayyhu leshalletaa keden itbarcha hay sharga, veitkafyayn kammeh, leanhara. kevan denaharin, keden itmennun kol chad vechad al ducheteh.

Kegavvna da, innun dargin illain, deikrun meore or, shaltin bimama, venaharin miggo butzina illaa. beshaata deramash lelya, hahu butzina illaa kanish lon, veail lon begavveh, ad denahir yemama. kevan dimvarchin yisrael al nehora bimama, keden appik lon bishlimu dinhora. veal da mevarchin yotzer hammeorot, vela amre bore, (sefer acher ella yotzer) (151 amud alef) vehacha bore meore haesh. begin deinnun dargin letatta.

Vecholla ihu raza deetzbean, behu ramiz dargin illain, vedargin tattain. (192 amud bet, tikun 18, 67 amud alef) dargin illain ishtemodan, bizkifu deetzbean leella. uvizkifu deetzbean, itbarchan dargin illain, vedargin tattain kachada. uvimichu deetzbean, itbarchan leanhara dargin tattain lechodayyhu.
Veraza da, tufere daachore etzbean. veetzbean lechodayyhu lego. tufere daachore etzbean, innun anpin acharanin, deitzterichu leanhara miggo hahu sheraga, veinnun anpin deikrun
914: Achorayim. etzbean lego bela tuferin, illen innun anpin penimain itkasyayn. veraza da, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. illen achore, (Bereshit 201 amud alef) etzbean, laachora betuferehon. ufanay lo yerau, illen etzbean lego, bela tuferin, deinnun anpin penimain.

Vechad mevarchenan al sheraga, bae leachazaa achore etzbean betuferin, leitnahara miggo hahu sheraga, ufenimae deetzbean, la itzterichu leachpayya (nusach acher leachazaa) lon leitnahara miggo hahu sheraga, deha innun la naharin, ella miggo sheraga illaa dilella leella, deihi temira ugeniza dela itgalyay kelal. veinnun la naharin miggo sheraga deitgalya kelal, begin kach bae leachazaa achore etzbean betuferin. ufenimae deetzbean, la bae leachazaa kamme hay sheraga. temirin innun, uvitmiru itnaharin. penimain innun, umippenimaa itnaharan. illain innun, umeillaa itnaharan. zakkain innun yisrael, bealma den, uvealma deate.

Uvae learcha bevusemin, kad nafik shabbeta, al deistallak hahu rucha, venafsha devar nash ishtearat beartula, (sefer acher ashetaneyt bakeratevapea) begin hahu seliku, deistallak rucha minneh veha ukemuha.

Ketiv (Bereshit 27:27) vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu vegomer. hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval ta chaze, recha ihu kiuma denafsha, begin deihu milla deail lenafsha, vela legufa. ta chaze, ketiv vayyarach et reach begadav, ha ukemuha, innun levushe deadam kadmaa havo, deyahav leh kudesha berich hu lealbasha lon.

Begin deha kad chav adam, itade minnih hahu levusha yakkira, deitlabbash beh bekadmita, kad ail leh beginta deeden. ulevatar dechav, albish leh bilvusha achara, levusha kadmaa, deitlabbash beh adam beginta deeden, ihu hava (meinnun malbushin) meinnun retichin, deikrun achorayim, veinnun levushin deikrun levushe tufera.

Vechad hava beginta deeden, kol innun retichin, vechol innun mashiryayn kaddishin, kullehu sacharin leh leadam, veitnetir mikkolla, vela hava yachil milla bisha leitkarva bahadeh. kevan dechav, veitadu minneh innun levushin, (sefer acher veitlavash bilvushin dechol mimmillin kulei) dachil mimmillin bishin, veruchin bishin, veistallaku minneh innun mashiryayn kaddishin, vela ishtaaru beh, ella innun rashe tufere deetzbean, desacharin lon letuferin sachranu dezuhama achara.

Uvegin kach, la live leh levar nash lerabbaa innun tuferin dezuhama, deha kema deasgiu, hachi name asge aleh kistura, veyidag vechol yoma, uvae lesappera lon, vela yirme lon, dela yavid kelana behahu atar, deyachil hahu bar nash leattezka. vecholla kegavvna illaa. deha lechullehu achorayim, sachara sitra achara, vela itzterich leh baatar dealma.

Levatar avad leh leadam, levushin acharanin, mittarpe ilanin deginta deeden deara. deha bekadmita havo innun levushin, meinnun achorayim deginta dilella, vehasheta migginta deara, venafke migginta. veinnun levushin havo sallekin rechin uvusemin deginta, denafsha mityayshsheva behu, vechadde behu. hada hu dichtiv vayyarach et reach begadav vayvarachehu, deha ityayshva nafsheh verucheh deyitzchak behahu recha.

Begin da kad nafak shabbeta, bae learcha bevusemin, leityashsheva nafsheh behahu recha, al hahu recha illaa kaddisha deistallak minnah. vehahu recha mealleya devusemin ihu hadas. deha kiuma daatar kaddisha denishmatin nafkin minneh, hadas ihu. veda ihu kiuma denafsha, kegavvna dilella, leitkayyeyma mehahu irtula deishtearat.

Kad nafak shabbeta, itlabbash adam, beinnun levushin deginta deeden deara, desallekin rechin uvusemin, lekayyeyma nafsheh, al hahu rucha kaddisha illaa yakkira deistallak minneh. vahadas ihu kiuma denafsha vadday. kegavvna illaa, deitkayyeyma kiuma denafsha.
Hahu rucha illaa denachit aleh devar nash bechedu, vechadde lenafsheh, keden kayyma nafsha devar nash, kegavvna dealma deate, dezammin
915: Leithanaa minneh, kema devar nash, ahani lehay rucha bealma da. hachi hahu rucha ahani leh levar nash, lealma deate, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) az titannag al Adonai vegomer. uchetiv vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. kema devar nash, rave lehahu innuga, veahane leh, hachi name ihu rave leh lealma deate. keden kad bar nash zache, veashlim shelimu diykara deshabbeta kidkaamran, kudesha berich hu kare aleh veamar, (Yeshayahu 49:3) vayyomer li avdi atta yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Kam ribbi abba, ushear chavrayyay, venashku resheh. bachu veamru, zakkaa chulakana dearcha da zammin kudesha berich hu lokovlan. amar ribbi abba, li zammin kudesha berich hu archa da, begin leitchabbera immechon. zakkaa ihu chulaki, dezachena learcha da.

Amar lehu, emma lechu ma dachamena, yoma da nafakna learcha, vachamena nehora chada, veitpelag litlat nehorin, veazlu kamay, veittamaru. vaamena vadday shechinta chamena, zakkaa chulaki. vehasheta innun telat nehorin dachamena, attun innun, vadday attun nehorin, uvutzinin illain, leanhara bealma den uvealma deate.

Amar ribbi abba ad hachi la yedana, dechol illen margelan setimin havo techot yadayychu, kevan dachamena, deha biruta defikkuda demarechon itamaru millin illen, yedana, dechullehu millin sallekin yoma da, lego kuresyyay illaa, venatil lon hahu mare deanpin, veavid minnayyhu itrin lemareh. veyoma da mitatterin (nusach acher shivin) shittin retichin kaddishin, likara dechurseyay, beillen millin deitammaru hacha, yoma da.

Addehachi zakaf enoy, vechama dearav shimsha. amar ribbi abba, nehach legabbe hay kefar, deihu kariv legabban bemadbera. azlu uveto tamman. befalgut lelya, kam ribbi abba ushear chavrayyay, leishtaddela beorayyta, amar ribbi abba, mikkan ulehala nima millin leitattera behu tzaddikayya divginta deeden, dehashta ihu zimna, dekudesha berich hu vechol tzaddikayya divginta deeden, tzayytin lekalehon detzaddikayya di beara.

Patach ribbi abba veamar, ketiv (Tehillim 115:16) hashshamayim shamayim laAdonai vehaaretz natan livne adam hay kera it leistakkela beh, vehachi itzterich lememar hashshamayim laAdonai, vehaaretz natan livni adam. may hashshamayim shamayim. ella hacha it leistakkela, begin deit shamayim, veit shamayim. shamayim letatta, veeretz letatta minnayyhu. shamayim leella, veeretz letatta minnayyhu. vechol dargin illain vetattain, kullehu kegavvna da, illen beillen.

Shamayim letatta, innun eser yeriot, kema deat amer (Tehillim 104:2) note shamayim kayria. vekudesha berich hu avad lon, umashiryayn di begavvavyyhu, leanhaga ara tattaa. teshiaa anhig letattae, desacharan kekufetra dekuleta. ashiraa, ihu ikkara.

Uvechullehu mashiryayn memanan ad sheviaa. mishsheviaa ulehala, it nehora deitpashshat letatta, miggo kuresyyay illaa, venahir laasiraa. vaasiraa, mehahu nehiru denakta, yahiv litshiaa, veihu litminaa uletatta.

Hay teminaa, kad itpakdun chele dechochavayya, veappik lon, hahu nehiru, kayyeyma veyahiv cheleh lechol chad vechad, leitmanaa behahu atar deitzterich. dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi bemispar tzevaam vegomer, merov onim, da ihu zohara dilella, deikre rov onim.

Uvechol rekia urekia, it memana, veitpekad al alma, veal ara, leanhaga kolla. bar ara deyisrael, dela anhig lah rekia, vela chela achara, ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy, veha ukemuha. vei tema hech sharya lemaggana rekia al ara deyisrael, veha mitra vetala merkia nachit ala, kishar kol ara achara.
Ella, vechol rekia urekia it memanan shaltin al alma,
916: Vehahu memana deshalta al hahu rekia, yahiv mechela deit leh lehahu rekia begin lemechav letatta, vehahu rekia nakit mehahu memana, veyahiv letatta leara. vehahu memana la nakit, ella mittamtzit dilella. aval ara kaddisha, la shallit al hahu rekia dealeh memana achara, vela chela achara, ella kudesha berich hu bilchodoy veihu pakid leara kaddisha behahu rekia.

Bechol rekia urekia, it pitchin yedian, veshuletanu dechol memanan, mippitcha lefitcha reshima, umehahu pitcha ulehallan, la shalta afillu kimlo nima, vela al da, (afillu) bitchuma defitcha dechavreh, bar kad ityehiv leh reshu, leshalletaa chad al chavreh. keden, shaltin malchin di beara, chad al chavreh.

Beemtzaita dechullehu rekiin, it pitcha chada, deikre gevilon, utechot hay pitcha, it shivin pitchin acharanin letatta, veshivin memanin natrin, merachik tere alfin ammin, dela keravin legabbeh. umehahu pitcha archa salik leella leella, ad di mata lego kuresyyay illaa, umehahu pitcha lechol sitrin dirkia, ad tara defitcha deikre magdon, (sefer acher 150) detamman ihu siyyuma dirkia ditchuma deara deyisrael.

Vechol innun 70 pitchin, dirshimin go hahu pitcha deikre gevilon, kullehu reshimin bechuresyyay kaddisha, vechullehu karinan lon shaare tzedek, dela shallit achara alayyhu. vekudesha berich hu pakid leara deyisrael behahu rekia, mippitcha lefitcha, bifkidu kema deitzterich. (141 amud alef) umitamtzita dehahu pekida, natlin innun shivin memanan, veyahavin lechullehu memanan acharanin.

Beginta deeden diltatta, rekia dekayyeyma aleh, it beh razin illain, kad avad kudesha berich hu rekia ayyte esh umayim, miggo kurese yekareh, veshittef lon kachada, veavad minnehon rekia letatta, veitpashatu ad dematu lehahu atar deginta deeden, veyatvu. ma avad kudesha berich hu. natal mishshamayim illain kaddishin, esh umayim acharanin demishtakkechin vela mishtakkechin, deitgalleyayn vela itgalleyayn, umeinnun esh umayim, deitnetalu mishshamayim illain, avad minnayyhu metichu dirkia, umatach leh al hay ginta diltatta, umitchabber go rekia achara.

Arba gavvnin, behahu metichu dirkia deal ginta, chivvar vesumak yarok veucham. legabbe hane gavvnin, it arba pitchin, letatta mehahu metichu dirkia. veinnun petichin learba sitrin dirkia deal gabbe ginta. meinnun esh umayim, deitavid minnehon hahu rekia. mitpattechin bearba pitchin, arba nehorin.

Listar yemina behahu pitcha, miggo metichu distar (nusach acher mayya) yemina, naharin teren nehorin, beinnun teren pitchin, befitcha dimina, uvefitcha deihu (nusach acher lego nafka nehora veihu anpin) lokovel anpin.

Go nehora denahir listar yemina, itreshim at chad, nahir uvalit, (nusach acher valehayt) venatzitz bintzitzu, miggo hahu nehora, veihu at 40, vekayyeyma beemtzaita dehahu nehora defitcha. at da, salleka venachta, vela kaim baatar chad. hahu nehora, natil lehahu at veappik lah, begin kach la kayyeyma baatar chad.

Go nehora denahir besitra deihu lokovel anpin, itreshim at chad, denahir uvalit venatzitz bintzitzu go hahu nehora, veihi at Rabbi, ulezimnin itchaze 2 (nusach acher 4) vekayyeyma beemtzaita dehahu nehora defitcha. vesalleka venachta, lezimnin itgalya, ulezimnin la itgalya, vela kayyeyma baatar chad. illen teren atvavn kayymin, vechad nishmeta detzaddikayya alat beginta deeden, illen teren atvavn nafkin miggo hahu nehora, vekayymin al hahi nishmeta, vesalke venachte.

Keden, meinnun teren pitchin, mekaddeme venachte meella, teren retichin. reticha chada illaa, deihi reticha demichael, rav seganin. reticha tinyayna, deihi reticha mehahu rav memana, deikre boel. veda ihu shamasha yakkira
917: Deikre refael. veinnun nachtin vekayymin al nishmeta, (47 amud alef) amrin lah shalom boech. (Yeshayahu 57:2) yavo shalom yavo shalom. keden innun teren atvavn, sallekin vekayymin beatrayyhu, veitgenizu go hahu nehora, deinnun pitchin.

Teren pitchin acharanin, teren nehorin acharanin ka melahatin, minhiru deeshsha, beinnun pitchin chad listar semala, vechad laachora. teren atvavn acharanin, melahatin beinnun nehorin, unetzitzin begavvavyyhu, at chad 3, veat chad 50, vechad atvavn kadmae mithadderan leatrayyhu, illen teren acharanin nitzotzin, sallekin venachtin, nafkin meinnun nehorin, vekayymin al nishmeta.

Keden nachtin teren retichin, meinnun teren pitchin. reticha chada ihu reticha degavriel, rav memana veyakkira. reticha tinyayna, ihi reticha achara kaddisha denuriel rav memana, venachtin meinnun pitchin, vekayymin al nishmeta, veatvavn mithadderan leatrayyhu.

Keden, illen teren retichin, alin lego hechala chada temira deginta, deikre ahalot, vetamman (132 amud alef) terisar zine busemin genizin, dichtiv, (Shir HaShirim 4:14) nird vecharkom kane vekinnamon vegomer. veinnun teresar zine devusemin diltatta.

Vetamman kol innun levushin denishmatin, deitchazun leitlabbesha behu, kol chad vechad, kadka chaze. behahu levusha, itreshimu kol innun ovadin tavin, deavad behay alma. vechullehu reshimin beh, umachrize hay ihu levusha diflanya, venatlin lehahu levusha veitlabbeshat beh hahi nishmeta detzaddikayya (vaychi 224 amud bet) divginta, kegavvna dediyyukena dehay alma.

Vehane mile, mittelatin yomin veelach, deha kol telatin yomin, let lach nishmeta dela tekabbel onsha, ad la teul leginta deeden. kevan dekabbilat onsha, alat leginta deeden, kema deukemuha. levatar deitlabbenat, itlabbeshat kevan deitlabbeshat behay levusha, yahavin lah atar kema deitchaze lah. keden, kol innun atvavn, nachtin, vesallekin innun retichin.
Hahu rekia ahaddar teren zimnin bechol yoma, behahu netilu dehay rekia achara, demitdavak beh. vehay rekia la nafik levar migginta. rekia da, merukkema bechol zine gavvnin.

Teren veesrin atvavn reshimin mechakkekan, behahu rekia, kol at veat, natif mimana (sefer acher mittalla), mittalla dilella al ginta. umehahu talla deatvavn itsachyayn innun nishmatin, umetasseyayn, batar detavlu binhar dinur leitdekaa. vetala la nachit, ella miggo atvavn dirshimin umechakkekan behahu rekia, begin deinnun atvavn kelala deorayyta. vehahu rekia raza deorayyta, deha meesh umayim deorayyta itavid.

Veal da innun nagdin talla, al kol innun deishtaddelu beorayyta lishmah behay alma. veillen millin reshimin beginta deeden, vesallekin ad hahu rekia venatlin meinnun atvavn hahu talla, leattezana hahi nishmeta. hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 32:2) yaarof kammatar likchi tizzal kattal imrati.

Beemtzaita dehay rekia, kayyeyma pitcha chada, lokovel pitcha dehechla dilella, divhahu pitcha, parchin nishmatin migginta diltatta leella, bechad ammuda denaitz (vaychi 219 amud alef) beginta, ad hahu pitcha.

Go hahu rekia (nusach acher ammuda) behahu pitcha deihu beemtzaita dirkia divginta, alin begavah telat gavvnin dinhora kelilan kachada, venaharan ligvavnin dehahu ammuda. ucheden rekia (nusach acher ammuda) da, natzitz veitlehit bechamma gavvnin (nusach acher nehorin) demitlahatan. bechol shaata, naharin tzaddikayya, mehahu ziva illaa. aval bechol shabbeta veshabbeta, uvechol resh yarcha, itgalyay shechinta, yattir mishshear zemani behay rekia, veatyayn kullehu tzaddikayya, vesagdin legabbeh.
Zakkaa chulakeh, man dezache lehane levushe dekaamaran, demitlabbeshan behu tzaddikayya beginta deeden (letatta). illen meovadin tavin, deavid
918: Bar nash, behay alma, befikkude orayyta. uvehon kayyeyma nishmeta beginta deeden letatta, veitlabbeshat behane levushin yakkirin.

Kad (229 amud bet) salleka nishmeta behahu pitcha dirkia leella, izdammenan lah levushin acharanin yakkirin illain, deinnun meruta vechavvana delibba beorayyta uvitzlota, dechad salleka hahu reuta leella, mitattar bah man demitattera, veishtear chulaka lehahu bar nash, veitaved minneh levushin dinhora, leitlabbesha behu nishmeta. lesalleka leella. veaf al gav deukemuha, deinnun levushin beovadin talyayn. illen la talyayn ella biruta derucha, kema deittemar, lekayyeyma go malachin ruchin kaddishin veda ihu beriru demilla. uvutzina kaddisha, olif hachi meeliyyahu, levushin diltatta beginta deara beovadin. levushin dilella, (sefer acher berucha biruta vakevavenaa delibba) biruta vechavvavna derucha belibba.

(Bereshit 2:10) (Vayikra 11 amud alef) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan vegomer, ha ukemuha, aval behay ginta diltatta, nahar yotze meeden vadday. veitzterich leminda, hay nahar denafik beginta diltatta, bean atar ikkara vesharsha dileh. bean atar, beeden. eden da raza illaa ihu, vela ityeyhiv reshu leshalletaa beh ena desuchletanu. veraza demilla ilmale atar da itmesar letatta leitgalaa, atar deeden illaa kaddisha, itmesar uf hachi leminda. ella (nusach acher aval) begin temiru diykara deeden illaa kaddisha, ittamar veitgeniz eden tattaa, dehahu nahar nagid venafik minneh. veal da la itmesar leitgallaa, afillu leinnun nishmatin divginta deeden.

Kema dehay nahar itperash venafik miggo eden, leashkaa leginta dilella, hachi name miggo hahu pitcha deemtzaita nafik chad nehora, deitperash led sitrin, bed pitchin dekaamaran. atar dekayymin innun atvavn reshiman. vehahu nehora deitperash learba nehorin, bed atvavn denitzotzin, (nusach acher venafkin) nafik meeden, atar dezahara nekuda leella.

Vehahu nekuda itnehir, veitavid eden leanhara. vela it man deshallit lemechome uleminda lehay nekuda, bar hahu nehiru deitpashshat minneh, desagdin lekammeh innun tzaddikayya divginta deeden, kema deittemar. vehay nekuda tattaa, ihi ginta legabbe eden illaa, atar dela ityeyhiv leminda uleistakkela.

Al kol da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha. shema da itperash, elohim zulatcha, da nekuda tattaa kaddisha, deihu yada hay eden diltatta, detamir beginta, velet achara man deyada leh. (Bereshit 26 amud alef) elohim zulatcha, da eden illaa al kolla, deihu raza dealma deate, deihu yada linkuda tattaa, bechad tzaddik denafik minneh, nahar deravve leh, velet man deyada leh bar ihu, dichtiv elohim zulatcha, deihu achid leella leella ad en sof.

Vehay nahar denafik meeden letatta, raza ihu lechakkimin, beraza dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehishbia betzachtzachot nafshecha. umilla da itperash leella vetatta. nishmeta denafka mehay alma dechashocha, ihi taivat lemechome binhiru dealma illaa, kehay bar nash detaiv lemishte bitivu lemayya, hachi kol chad vechad, ihu tzachtzachot, kema deat amar, (Yeshayahu Adonai:13) tziche tzama. tzama, meinnun tzachot dinhorin deginta urekia vehechalin deginta.

Vehahu nahar denafik meeden, kol innun nishmatin bilvushe yekar, yatvin al hahu nahar, veilmale hahu levusha, la yachlin lemisbal. ucheden mityayshshevan, veravvavn beinnun tzachot, veyachle lemisbal. vehahu nahar ihu tikkuna denishmatin, leityayshsheva, uleittezna uleithanaa, meinnun tzachot venishmatin ithakkenan (nusach acher atetakenan) al hahu nahar, umityayshshevan beh.
Hahu nahar illaa dilella, appik nishmatin, ufarchin minneh, lego ginta, dehay nahar diltatta beginta deara, atkin nishmatin, leittakkena leityayshsheva, beinnun
919: Tzachot. kegavvna da behay alma levar, berecha demayay mityayshsheva nafsha leitnahara, deha meikkara kegavvna da nafka. uvegin demittatkenin nishmatin al hahu nahar denagid venafik meeden, yachlin leityayshsheva beinnun tzachot illain, ulesalleka leella. behahu pitcha deemtzaita dirkia (vaychi 219 amud alef) vechad ammuda dekaim beemtzaut ginta dekaamaran.

Behahu ammuda sallekin leella, bego hahu pitcha dirkia, uveh sacharaneh, it beh (Yeshayahu 4:Adonai) anan veashan venoga. veaf al gav deukemuha lehay kera, aval anan veashan illen millevar, venoga millegav. veda ihu lechafyay al innun desallekin leella, dela yitchazun mikkamme innun deyatvin letatta.

Veha hacha raza derazin, kad (nusach acher bae kudesha berich hu leittakna hay nekuda vechulei) hay nekuda baa leittakna betikkunoy, uleitkashsheta, beshabbate uvizmanni uvechagge, meshadder arba anpin denesher, vekayymin al hechala deikre deror, vehayeynu mar deror. uvegin da beshatta deyovla, baenan leachreza deror, kema deat amer (Vayikra 25:10) ukeratem deror. veinnun arba anpin yahavin kala, velet man deyishma leh, bar innun nishmatin deitchazun lesalleka, veinnun mitkanneshin tamman, venatle lon illen 4 anpin, veaalin lon lego, behahu ammuda dekayyeyma beemtzaita.

Uvehahi shaata salleka hahu ammuda, deanana veeshsha utenana, venoga millegav. veillen teren ikrun, (Yeshayahu 4:Adonai) mechon har tziyyon umikraeha. mechon har tziyyon, da ihu tikkuna dilella, kad nekuda tattaa mitkashsheta, veinnun mikraeha dehahi nekuda leitkashsheta.

Kevan desallekin illen nishmatin ad hahu pitcha dirkia, keden, hahu rekia sachara sacharane deginta, telat zimnin. umikal neimu desachara hahu rekia, nafkin kol innun nishmatin veshamin hahu neimu dehahu rekia, vechaman hahu ammuda, desalleka eshsha vaanana utenana venoga delahit, vesagdin kullehu. keden nishmatin sallekin behahu pitcha, ad desallekin lego iggula, desachara behahi (nusach acher lehahu) nekuda. keden chaman ma dechaman. umiggo nehiru vechedvavta mehahu dechaman, sallekin venachtin karvin verachakin.

Veihi taiva legabbayyhu, umitkashsheta binhiru. keden albish kina (minnehora) chad tzaddik illaa, veistakkal binhora ushefiru dehay nekuda, uvetikunaha, veachid bah, vesalik lah legabbeh, venahir nehora binhora, vahavu chad. kol chela dishmayyay patche behahi shaata veamre, zakkain attun tzaddikayyay, natre orayyta, zakkain innun demishtaddelin beorayyta, deha chedvavta demarechon havi bechu, deha atara demarechon, mitatter bechon.

Keden kevan denaharin nehora binhora, teren nehorin mitchabberan kachada, venaharin. levatar innun gavvnin nachtin, veistakkelan leishtashea beinnun nishmatin detzaddikayyay, umetakkeni lon leatra leella. veal da ittemar, ayin la raata elokim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, ketiv (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia keen hakerach hannora natuy al rashehem millemala. hay kera ukemuha, aval it rakia veit rakia, rakia diltatta ihu kayyeyma al gabbe 4 chevavn. umittamman itpashat veshari diyyukena dechad nukeba, deachore dechura, veda ihu raza dichtiv, (Shemot 33:23) veraita et achoray. kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:5) achor vakedem tzartani. uchetiv (Bereshit 2:21) vayyikkach achat mitztzalotav.

Rakia dilella ihu kayyeyma al gabbe chevavn illain, umittamman itpashat veshari diyyukena dechad dechura, deihu raza illaa. vehani teren rekiin, chad ikre ketze hashshamayim. vechad ikre miktze hashshamayim. dichtiv, (Devarim 4:32) ulemiktze hashshamayim vead ketze hashshamayim. rashe hachayya diltatta innun arba chevavn, deinnun reshimin (nusach acher nehorin) illain, al innun arba atvavn reshimin, di bego innun arba pitchin, divginta deeden.
Veaf al gav deamaran eden diltatta beara, hachi hu vadday. aval kolla raza illaa ihu, kema deittemar
